title: The Book of Leviticus Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Leviticus — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the Lord called to Moses and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.
verses.decoded: Tell the Israelites, and say to them, 'If any of you brings an offering to the LORD, you must bring your offering from the livestock, specifically from the herd or from the flock.'

verses.kjv: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.
verses.decoded: If someone brings an offering that is a burnt sacrifice from the cattle, he must present a male animal that has no physical defects. He must willingly bring it to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, in the presence of the Lord.

verses.kjv: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
verses.decoded: He is to place his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it will be accepted on his behalf to make atonement for him.

verses.kjv: And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: And the offerer shall slaughter the young bull in the presence of the Lord. Then the priests, who are Aaron's sons, shall bring the blood and splash it all around on the altar, which is located at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.
verses.decoded: And he shall remove the skin from the burnt offering, and cut it into its pieces.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:
verses.decoded: Then Aaron's sons, who are priests, must place fire on the altar and arrange the wood on top of the fire.

verses.kjv: And the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
verses.decoded: And Aaron's sons, the priests, are to arrange the pieces, including the head and the fat, on the wood that is burning on the altar.

verses.kjv: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: However, the internal organs and the legs of the animal must be washed with water. Then the priest is to burn the entire offering on the altar. This is to be a burnt offering, a sacrifice presented by fire, which is pleasing to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And if his offering be of the flocks, namely, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.
verses.decoded: If the offering he presents is from his livestock, specifically from the sheep or the goats, as a burnt offering, he must bring a male animal that is without any physical defect.

verses.kjv: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.
verses.decoded: He is to kill it on the north side of the altar, in the presence of the Lord. Then the priests, Aaron's sons, are to sprinkle its blood all around on the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
verses.decoded: The animal is to be cut into its parts, including its head and its fat. Then, the priest must arrange these parts in order on the wood that is burning on the altar.

verses.kjv: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: However, the internal organs and the legs must be washed with water. Then the priest is to take all of it and burn it on the altar. This is a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD be of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.
verses.decoded: And if the burnt offering that a person presents to the LORD consists of birds, then that person must bring an offering of turtledoves or young pigeons.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:
verses.decoded: The priest is to bring the bird to the altar, twist off its head, and burn it on the altar; its blood must be drained out at the side of the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:
verses.decoded: The priest must remove the bird's crop, including its contents and feathers, and throw it to the east side of the altar, where the ashes are collected.

verses.kjv: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: The priest is to tear the bird open by its wings, but not separate it completely. Then the priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is already on the fire. This is a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And when any will offer a meat offering unto the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:
verses.decoded: When anyone presents a grain offering to the Lord, their offering must consist of fine flour; and they are to pour oil on it and place frankincense on it.

verses.kjv: And he shall bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD:
verses.decoded: And he must bring it to Aaron's sons, who are the priests. From it, he must take a handful of the fine flour and a handful of the olive oil, along with all the frankincense. Then the priest must burn this portion as a memorial offering on the altar. This is an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the remnant of the meat offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
verses.decoded: The remaining portion of the grain offering will belong to Aaron and his sons; it is considered extremely sacred among the offerings presented to the LORD by fire.

verses.kjv: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
verses.decoded: And if you bring an offering of a grain offering baked in an oven, it must be unleavened cakes made of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers spread with oil.

verses.kjv: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.
verses.decoded: And if your offering is a grain offering baked in a pan, it must be made of fine, unleavened flour mixed with oil.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meat offering.
verses.decoded: You must break it into pieces and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.

verses.kjv: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
verses.decoded: And if your offering is a grain offering baked in a frying pan, it must be made from fine flour with oil.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the LORD: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.
verses.decoded: You must bring the grain offering, which is prepared from these ingredients, to the Lord. When it is presented to the priest, he will bring it to the altar.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: The priest will take a portion of the grain offering as a token and burn it on the altar. It is an offering presented by fire, a pleasing aroma to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And that which is left of the meat offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
verses.decoded: The remainder of the grain offering will belong to Aaron and his sons; it is considered extremely sacred among the offerings made to the Lord by fire.

verses.kjv: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the LORD, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the LORD made by fire.
verses.decoded: No grain offering that you present to the Lord must contain yeast, because you must not burn any yeast or any honey in any offering made to the Lord by fire.

verses.kjv: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the LORD: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.
verses.decoded: Regarding the offering of the first harvest, you must present them to the Lord; however, they must not be burned on the altar as a pleasing aroma.

verses.kjv: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.
verses.decoded: Every grain offering you present must be seasoned with salt. You must not allow the salt, which symbolizes your covenant with your God, to be absent from your grain offering. With all your offerings, you are to present salt.

verses.kjv: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the LORD, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.
verses.decoded: And if you present a grain offering from your first harvest to the LORD, for your grain offering from your first harvest, you shall present fresh ears of grain, dried by fire, specifically, crushed grain from ripe ears.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meat offering.
verses.decoded: You are to pour oil on it and place frankincense on it; it is a grain offering.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten corn thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: The priest will burn a portion of it as a symbolic reminder, specifically a portion of its crushed grain and a portion of its oil, along with all of its frankincense. This is a burnt offering presented to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer it of the herd; whether it be a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.
verses.decoded: If his offering is a peace offering sacrifice, and he presents it from his livestock (cattle), whether male or female, he must present it without any defect before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.decoded: The person presenting the offering is to place their hand on the head of the animal being offered, and then kill it at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting. After this, Aaron's sons, who are the priests, must sprinkle the blood all around the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.decoded: And he must present from the peace offering sacrifice a burnt offering to the Lord; the fat covering the internal organs, and all the fat attached to the internal organs,

verses.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.decoded: He must remove the two kidneys, along with the fat on them that is near the animal's flanks, and the fatty membrane covering the liver, which is to be removed with the kidneys.

verses.kjv: And Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: Then Aaron's sons are to burn it on the altar, on top of the burnt offering that is already on the wood and burning. This is an offering presented by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the LORD be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.
verses.decoded: And if the animal he presents as a peace offering to the Lord is from the flock (sheep or goats), whether male or female, he must present it without any defect.

verses.kjv: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the LORD.
verses.decoded: If someone presents a lamb as their offering, then they must present it before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.
verses.decoded: He is to place his hand on the head of his offering, and then slaughter it in front of the Tent of Meeting. And Aaron's sons are to sprinkle its blood all around the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat thereof, and the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.decoded: From the sacrifice of the peace offering, he must present an offering made by fire to the LORD. He must remove all the fat from it: the entire fatty tail, which he is to cut off close to the backbone; the fat covering the internal organs; all the fat attached to the internal organs; both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins; and the fatty lobe of the liver, which he is to remove along with the kidneys.

verses.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.decoded: He must remove both kidneys, along with the fat covering them near the loins, and the fatty membrane (caul) that is above the liver, which is to be removed with the kidneys.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: And the priest is to burn it on the altar; it serves as the sustenance for the offering presented by fire to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And if his offering be a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.
verses.decoded: If his offering is a goat, then he must present it before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.
verses.decoded: And he must place his hand on its head and slaughter it in front of the Tent of Meeting; and Aaron's sons are to sprinkle its blood all around the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall offer thereof his offering, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.decoded: From it, he must present his offering, which is a food offering made by fire to the Lord. This includes the fat covering the internal organs and all the fat attached to them.

verses.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.decoded: He must remove both kidneys, along with the fat covering them near the flanks, and the fatty membrane (omentum) that is above the liver, which is to be removed with the kidneys.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat is the LORD’s.
verses.decoded: The priest is to burn these portions on the altar; this is the offering consumed by fire, presented as a pleasing aroma. All the fat belongs to the Lord.

verses.kjv: It shall be a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.
verses.decoded: This will be a lasting regulation for your descendants, wherever you live, that you must not eat any fat or any blood.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:
verses.decoded: Tell the Israelites: If a person unintentionally violates any of the LORD's commands regarding actions that are forbidden, and commits one of these forbidden acts,

verses.kjv: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.
verses.decoded: If the consecrated priest commits a sin that brings guilt upon the people, then he must present a young bull, one without any defect, to the LORD as an offering for his sin which he has committed.

verses.kjv: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock’s head, and kill the bullock before the LORD.
verses.decoded: He must bring the young bull to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting in the presence of the Lord. He must then place his hand on the bull's head and slaughter it before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock’s blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.decoded: The anointed priest must take some of the bull's blood and bring it into the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the vail of the sanctuary.
verses.decoded: The priest will dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times in the presence of the Lord, in front of the curtain of the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which is in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: The priest is to apply some of the blood to the projections (horns) of the altar used for burning fragrant incense, which stands before the Lord and is located inside the Tent of Meeting (or Tabernacle of Assembly). Then, the priest must pour the remaining blood from the young bull at the base of the altar designated for burnt offerings, which is situated at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.decoded: And he must remove all the fat from the bull used for the sin offering; specifically, the fat covering the internal organs, and all the fat attached to those internal organs,

verses.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,
verses.decoded: He must remove both kidneys, along with the fat covering them near the loins, and the fatty membrane over the liver, which is to be removed with the kidneys.

verses.kjv: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.
verses.decoded: Just as it was removed from the young bull used for the peace offering sacrifice, the priest must burn these parts on the altar of the burnt offering.

verses.kjv: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,
verses.decoded: The bull's hide, all its meat, including its head, its legs, its internal organs, and its waste,

verses.kjv: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.
verses.decoded: He must carry the entire young bull outside the camp to a ritually clean place where the ashes are deposited, and there he shall burn it on wood with fire.

verses.kjv: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which should not be done, and are guilty;
verses.decoded: If the entire community of Israel unintentionally commits a sin, and the transgression remains unknown to the assembly, and they have acted contrary to any of the Lord's commandments regarding forbidden actions, they are still considered guilty.

verses.kjv: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: When the sin they committed against it becomes known, then the community must offer a young bull for the sin and bring it before the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD: and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD.
verses.decoded: Then the leaders of the community are to place their hands on the head of the young bull in the presence of the Lord, and the young bull is to be slaughtered before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock’s blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.decoded: The consecrated priest must bring some of the bull's blood into the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, even before the vail.
verses.decoded: Then the priest is to dip his finger into some of the blood and sprinkle it seven times in the presence of the Lord, specifically in front of the curtain.

verses.kjv: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before the LORD, that is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: And he must apply some of the blood to the corners (horns) of the altar that stands before the Lord, which is located within the Tent of Meeting. He must then pour out the remaining blood at the base of the altar designated for burnt offerings.

verses.kjv: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn it upon the altar.
verses.decoded: And the priest must remove all the fat from the animal and burn it on the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
verses.decoded: And he must deal with this bull in the same manner as he dealt with the bull for the sin offering; the priest will perform the ritual of atonement for them, and they will be forgiven.

verses.kjv: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it is a sin offering for the congregation.
verses.decoded: And he must take the young bull outside the camp and burn it, just as he burned the first young bull. This is a sin offering for the community.

verses.kjv: When a ruler hath sinned, and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD his God concerning things which should not be done, and is guilty;
verses.decoded: When a leader has sinned by unintentionally doing something forbidden by any of the commands of the Lord his God, and is therefore guilty;

verses.kjv: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:
verses.decoded: Or if he becomes aware of the sin he has committed, he must bring his offering, a young goat, a male without any defect.

verses.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD: it is a sin offering.
verses.decoded: He is to place his hand on the head of the goat and slaughter it in the designated area where burnt offerings are killed before the Lord; this is a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.
verses.decoded: The priest will take some of the blood from the sin offering with his finger and put it on the corners (horns) of the altar where burnt offerings are made. He will then pour the rest of the blood at the base of that same altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.decoded: And the priest must burn all of its fat on the altar, just as he burns the fat from the sacrifice of peace offerings. In this way, the priest will perform a ritual of purification for the person's sin, and that person will be forgiven.

verses.kjv: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;
verses.decoded: If any ordinary person unintentionally commits a sin by doing something forbidden by any of the LORD's commands, and becomes guilty;

verses.kjv: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.
verses.decoded: If he becomes aware of the sin he has committed, then he must bring as his offering a young female goat without any defects, for the sin he has committed.

verses.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.
verses.decoded: The individual is to place their hand on the head of the animal designated as the sin offering, and then kill this sin offering in the same area where the burnt offerings are slaughtered.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.
verses.decoded: The priest is to take some of its blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar where burnt offerings are made. He must then pour out all the rest of its blood at the base of the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.decoded: And he must remove all its fat, just as the fat is removed from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest must burn it on the altar as a pleasing aroma to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.
verses.decoded: If someone brings a lamb as an offering for sin, they must bring a female lamb that has no defects.

verses.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.
verses.decoded: The person presenting the offering must place their hand on the head of the animal designated for the sin offering. Then, they are to kill it as a sin offering in the same location where the animals for the burnt offering are killed.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:
verses.decoded: The priest is to take some of the blood from the purification offering with his finger and put it on the projections of the altar for burnt offerings. He must then pour out all the remaining blood at the base of the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.decoded: And the priest must remove all its fat, just as the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of the fellowship offerings. Then the priest must burn the fat on the altar, along with the offerings made by fire to the Lord. In this way, the priest will make atonement for the person's sin, and it will be forgiven.

verses.kjv: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it; if he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.decoded: If a person sins by hearing a public oath or curse and is a witness, whether they have seen or known about the matter, and they do not disclose it, then they will be held responsible for their wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether it be a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and if it be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.
verses.decoded: Or if a person touches anything ritually unclean, whether it is the dead body of an unclean wild animal, or the dead body of unclean livestock, or the dead body of unclean small creatures that move on the ground, and this fact is not immediately apparent to them, they will also become ritually unclean and incur guilt.

verses.kjv: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness it be that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty.
verses.decoded: Or if someone touches human impurity, whatever kind of impurity it may be that makes a person unclean, and they were unaware of it; when they later become aware of it, then they will be held accountable.

verses.kjv: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty in one of these.
verses.decoded: Or if a person thoughtlessly makes a vow, speaking with their lips to do something harmful or something beneficial, whatever it may be that someone declares with an oath, and then forgets about it;

verses.kjv: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these things, that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that thing:
verses.decoded: And it will happen that when someone is guilty of one of these things, they must confess that they have sinned in that matter.

verses.kjv: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.
verses.decoded: And that person must bring their guilt offering to the LORD for the sin they have committed, a female animal from the flock, either a lamb or a young goat,...

verses.kjv: And if he be not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he hath committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, unto the LORD; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.
verses.decoded: If he cannot afford to bring a lamb, then he must bring to the LORD, for the offense he has committed, two turtledoves or two young pigeons: one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide it asunder:
verses.decoded: He must bring them to the priest, who will first present the one designated for the sin offering. The priest will then twist its head from its neck, but without completely separating it.

verses.kjv: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it is a sin offering.
verses.decoded: And he must sprinkle some of the blood from the sin offering on the side of the altar; and the remaining blood must be drained out at the base of the altar. This is considered a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And he shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the manner: and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.decoded: And he must offer the second bird as a burnt offering, in the prescribed way. Then the priest will perform the ritual of atonement for the sin that the person has committed, and that sin will be forgiven.

verses.kjv: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin offering.
verses.decoded: However, if he cannot afford to bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons, then the person who sinned must bring a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as an offering for his sin. He must not put any olive oil on it, nor any frankincense, because it is a sin offering.

verses.kjv: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, even a memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: it is a sin offering.
verses.decoded: Then he must bring it to the priest, and the priest must take a handful of it as a symbolic portion, and burn it on the altar, in accordance with the fire offerings made to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and the remnant shall be the priest’s, as a meat offering.
verses.decoded: And the priest will perform a ritual of reconciliation for him concerning the sin he has committed in one of these ways, and he will be forgiven; the remaining portion of the offering.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the LORD; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the LORD a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:
verses.decoded: If a person commits an offense and unintentionally sins concerning the sacred things of the Lord, then for their offense, they must bring to the Lord an unblemished ram from the flock, valued in silver shekels according to the sanctuary's standard, as a guilt offering.

verses.kjv: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.decoded: And he must compensate for the damage he has caused to the sacred object or offering, and must add one-fifth of its value to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest will perform a ritual of atonement for him with the ram designated for the trespass offering, and he will be forgiven.

verses.kjv: And if a soul sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the LORD; though he wist it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.
verses.decoded: If a person sins by doing something that the Lord's commands forbid, even if they were unaware of it, they are still guilty and must bear the consequences of their wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.decoded: And that person must bring a flawless ram from the flock, according to your assessment of its value, as a guilt offering to the priest. The priest will then perform a ritual of atonement for that person concerning the unintentional error they committed, and they will be forgiven.

verses.kjv: It is a trespass offering: he hath certainly trespassed against the LORD.
verses.decoded: It is an offering for a transgression; he has certainly committed a transgression against the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against the LORD, and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived his neighbour;
verses.decoded: If a person sins and acts unfaithfully against the Lord by lying to their neighbor regarding something entrusted to them for safekeeping, or in a partnership, or concerning something taken by force, or has defrauded their neighbor;

verses.kjv: Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:
verses.decoded: Or if someone finds something that was lost and then lies about it, or swears a false oath concerning it; in any of these actions that a person commits, they are sinning.

verses.kjv: Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,
verses.decoded: Therefore, if someone has sinned and is found guilty, they must return what they took by force, or what they obtained through deception, or what was entrusted to them for safekeeping, or a lost item they found, or anything about which they have sworn falsely. They must fully restore the original amount, add an additional one-fifth to it, and give it to the rightful owner on the day they present their trespass offering.

verses.kjv: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.
verses.decoded: Or for anything about which he has sworn falsely; he must fully restore the original amount, and add an additional one-fifth to it, and give it to the person to whom it belongs, on the day he presents his guilt offering.

verses.kjv: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:
verses.decoded: And he must bring his offering for wrongdoing to the Lord, a male sheep without any physical defects from the flock, valued according to your assessment, as an offering for wrongdoing, to the priest.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD: and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing therein.
verses.decoded: The priest will make atonement for him before the Lord, and he will be forgiven for any of the things he has done in committing that offense.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, instructing him to tell Aaron and his sons the following: This is the regulation concerning the burnt offering. The burnt offering must remain on the altar, burning throughout the entire night until morning, and the fire on the altar must be kept burning.

verses.kjv: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.
verses.decoded: Instruct Aaron and his sons, saying, 'This is the regulation for the burnt offering: The burnt offering itself is to remain on the altar's hearth throughout the entire night until morning, and the altar's fire must be kept burning on it.'

verses.kjv: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
verses.decoded: The priest must wear his linen tunic and put on his linen undergarments directly on his body. Then, he must remove the ashes that the fire has produced from the burnt offering on the altar and place them next to the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.
verses.decoded: And he must remove his clothes, and put on different clothes, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a ritually pure place.

verses.kjv: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.
verses.decoded: The fire on the altar must be kept burning; it must not be extinguished. Every morning, the priest is to burn wood on it, arrange the burnt offering on it, and then burn the fat from the peace offerings on it.

verses.kjv: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.
verses.decoded: The fire must always be kept burning on the altar; it must never be allowed to go out.

verses.kjv: And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar.
verses.decoded: This is the regulation for the grain offering: Aaron's sons are to present it before the Lord, in front of the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour, even the memorial of it, unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: The priest is to take a handful of the fine flour from the grain offering, along with some of its oil and all the frankincense that is on the grain offering, and burn it on the altar as a pleasing aroma, a memorial portion to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.
verses.decoded: Aaron and his sons are to eat the remaining portion of it. It must be eaten with unleavened bread in a sacred place; they are to eat it in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as is the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.
verses.decoded: It must not be baked with yeast. I have given it to them as their share from my offerings made by fire; it is exceptionally sacred, just like the sin offering and the trespass offering.

verses.kjv: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the LORD made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.
verses.decoded: All the male descendants of Aaron are permitted to eat from it. This is to be a permanent regulation for all your future generations concerning the offerings presented to the Lord by fire.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the LORD in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.
verses.decoded: This is the offering that Aaron and his sons are to present to the Lord on the day he is consecrated: one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a regular grain offering, half of it in the morning and half of it in the evening.

verses.kjv: In a pan it shall be made with oil; and when it is baken, thou shalt bring it in: and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: It is to be prepared in a pan with oil; and when it is baked, you must bring it in. You must then offer the baked portions of the grain offering as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: it is a statute for ever unto the LORD; it shall be wholly burnt.
verses.decoded: The priest among his sons who is appointed to succeed him shall present this offering. This is a permanent regulation for the Lord; the entire offering must be completely burned.

verses.kjv: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.
verses.decoded: Every grain offering presented by a priest must be completely burned; it is not to be eaten.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the LORD: it is most holy.
verses.decoded: Tell Aaron and his sons that this is the regulation for the sin offering: The sin offering must be slaughtered in the same location where the burnt offering is slaughtered, in the presence of the LORD; it is considered extremely sacred.

verses.kjv: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: The priest who offers it as a sin offering is to eat it. It must be eaten in a holy place, specifically in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.
verses.decoded: Anything that touches its flesh will become consecrated. If any of its blood is splattered on a garment, you must wash the stained part in a holy place.

verses.kjv: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.
verses.decoded: However, the clay pot in which it is boiled must be broken; but if it is boiled in a bronze pot, it must be thoroughly scoured and rinsed with water.

verses.kjv: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.
verses.decoded: All the male priests are permitted to eat from it, because it is considered extremely sacred.

verses.kjv: And no sin offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place, shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.decoded: However, any sin offering whose blood is brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place must not be eaten; it must be completely burned with fire.

verses.kjv: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.
verses.decoded: Similarly, these are the regulations for the guilt offering: it is considered extremely sacred.

verses.kjv: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.
verses.decoded: In the same area where the burnt offering is slaughtered, the trespass offering must also be slaughtered. The priest is then to sprinkle its blood all around the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
verses.decoded: And from it, he must offer all its fat: the fatty tail and the fat covering the internal organs.

verses.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:
verses.decoded: He must remove the two kidneys and the fat covering them, which is located near the animal's flanks, along with the fatty membrane (omentum) that covers the liver.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it is a trespass offering.
verses.decoded: The priest must burn these parts on the altar as a sacrifice presented by fire to the Lord; it is a guilt offering.

verses.kjv: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it is most holy.
verses.decoded: Every male priest may eat of it; it must be eaten in a sacred place, because it is supremely holy.

verses.kjv: As the sin offering is, so is the trespass offering: there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it.
verses.decoded: The sin offering and the trespass offering are to be handled identically; they are subject to the same law. The priest who performs the ritual of atonement with these offerings will receive them.

verses.kjv: And the priest that offereth any man’s burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.
verses.decoded: The priest who presents a person's burnt offering will keep the hide of that burnt offering for himself.

verses.kjv: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest’s that offereth it.
verses.decoded: And every grain offering that is baked in an oven, and everything prepared in a frying pan or in a shallow pan, will belong to the priest who presents it.

verses.kjv: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.
verses.decoded: Every grain offering, whether mixed with oil or dry, all the sons of Aaron shall receive an equal share.

verses.kjv: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: This is the regulation for the peace offering that someone must present to the Lord.

verses.kjv: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.
verses.decoded: If someone presents it as a thank offering, then along with the thank offering sacrifice, they must present unleavened flatbreads mixed with olive oil, and unleavened thin cakes brushed with olive oil, and flatbreads made from fine flour, fried in olive oil.

verses.kjv: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.
verses.decoded: In addition to the cakes, he must present leavened bread as part of his offering, along with the thank offering that is part of his fellowship offerings.

verses.kjv: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto the LORD, and it shall be the priest’s that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.
verses.decoded: From this offering, he must present one portion from the entire gift as a raised offering to the Lord, and it will belong to the priest who sprinkles the blood of the fellowship offerings.

verses.kjv: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
verses.decoded: The meat from the sacrifice of his peace offering, given as an expression of thanksgiving, must be eaten on the same day it is offered; none of it is to be left until the next morning.

verses.kjv: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:
verses.decoded: However, if the animal sacrifice he presents is made as a solemn promise or a freewill gift, it must be consumed on the very day he offers his sacrifice; and on the following day, any remaining portion of it may also be eaten.

verses.kjv: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
verses.decoded: However, any meat from the sacrifice that is left over until the third day must be completely consumed by fire.

verses.kjv: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.
verses.decoded: If any of the meat from the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted, nor will it be credited to the one who offered it. It will be considered detestable, and the person who eats it will be held accountable for their wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.
verses.decoded: The meat that comes into contact with anything ritually impure must not be consumed; it is to be destroyed by fire. However, regarding the meat, anyone who is ritually pure is permitted to eat it.

verses.kjv: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.decoded: However, any person who eats the meat from the sacrifice of peace offerings, which belongs to the LORD, while that person is in a state of ritual impurity, that individual must be removed from their community.

verses.kjv: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing, as the uncleanness of man, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which pertain unto the LORD, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, if a person touches anything unclean, such as human uncleanness, an unclean animal, or any other detestable unclean thing, and then eats the meat from the sacrifice of peace offerings that belongs to the Lord, that person must be removed from their community.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.
verses.decoded: Tell the Israelites that they must not eat any fat from an ox, a sheep, or a goat.

verses.kjv: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.
verses.decoded: The fat from an animal that dies naturally, and the fat from an animal that has been killed by wild animals, may be used for other purposes; however, you must not eat it under any circumstances.

verses.kjv: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.
verses.decoded: For anyone who eats the fat of an animal from which people present a food offering by fire to the Lord, that person who eats it will be cut off.

verses.kjv: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, you must not eat any kind of blood, whether from birds or animals, in any of your settlements.

verses.kjv: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.decoded: Any person who eats any kind of blood will be removed from their community.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the LORD shall bring his oblation unto the LORD of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
verses.decoded: Tell the people of Israel that whoever presents a sacrifice from his peace offerings to the LORD must personally bring his offering to the LORD from that peace offering sacrifice.

verses.kjv: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.decoded: The individual himself must present the offerings to the Lord that are prepared by fire. He must bring the fat along with the breast, so that the breast can be presented as a wave offering before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
verses.decoded: The priest must burn the fat on the altar, but the breast portion will belong to Aaron and his sons.

verses.kjv: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
verses.decoded: You must give the right shoulder to the priest as a special offering from your peace offerings.

verses.kjv: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.
verses.decoded: The priest among Aaron's descendants who offers the blood and the fat from the peace offerings will receive the right shoulder as his portion.

verses.kjv: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: Indeed, the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the heave offering I have taken from the people of Israel, from their peace offerings, and I have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as a perpetual ordinance for the Israelites.

verses.kjv: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto the LORD in the priest’s office;
verses.decoded: This is the designated share from the anointing ceremony for Aaron and for his sons, taken from the offerings made to the Lord by fire, on the day when he brought them forward to serve the Lord as priests;

verses.kjv: Which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, by a statute for ever throughout their generations.
verses.decoded: The LORD commanded that these portions be given to them by the Israelites on the day He consecrated them, as a permanent regulation for all their future generations.

verses.kjv: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;
verses.decoded: These are the regulations concerning the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the guilt offering, the ordination offerings, and the sacrifice of the fellowship offerings.

verses.kjv: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.decoded: These are the instructions that the Lord gave to Moses on Mount Sinai, at the time when he commanded the Israelites to bring their offerings to the Lord in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;
verses.decoded: Bring Aaron and his sons, along with the special priestly garments, the anointing oil, a young bull for the purification offering, two male sheep, and a basket of bread made without yeast.

verses.kjv: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: And you shall gather the entire assembly together at the entrance of the meeting tent.

verses.kjv: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded him, and the community gathered at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.
verses.decoded: And Moses said to the assembly, 'This is what the Lord commanded to be done.'

verses.kjv: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
verses.decoded: Then Moses brought Aaron and his sons and washed them with water.

verses.kjv: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.
verses.decoded: He then dressed him in the tunic, fastened the sash around him, put the robe on him, and placed the ephod on him. He secured it with the skillfully woven waistband of the ephod, binding it firmly to him.

verses.kjv: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.
verses.decoded: He placed the breastplate on him; he also placed the Urim and the Thummim inside the breastplate.

verses.kjv: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And he placed the turban on Aaron's head; also, on the front of the turban, he attached the golden plate, which was the holy crown, just as the Lord had instructed Moses.

verses.kjv: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.
verses.decoded: Then Moses took the anointing oil and applied it to the sacred tent, along with everything within it, thereby consecrating them.

verses.kjv: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.
verses.decoded: He sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its utensils, including the basin and its stand, to consecrate them.

verses.kjv: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
verses.decoded: And he poured some of the special oil used for anointing onto Aaron's head, and by anointing him, he made him holy for his sacred duties.

verses.kjv: And Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: Then Moses presented Aaron's sons, and he dressed them in tunics, fastened sashes around their waists, and placed head coverings on them, just as the Lord had instructed Moses.

verses.kjv: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.
verses.decoded: And he presented the young bull for the purification offering; then Aaron and his sons placed their hands on the head of the young bull designated for the purification offering.

verses.kjv: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.
verses.decoded: Then he slaughtered the animal; and Moses took some of its blood and, using his finger, applied it to the projections on all sides of the altar, thus purifying the altar. He then poured the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

verses.kjv: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it upon the altar.
verses.decoded: He took all the fat that covered the internal organs, the fatty membrane over the liver, and the two kidneys with their surrounding fat, and Moses burned them on the altar.

verses.kjv: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: However, the young bull, along with its hide, its meat, and its waste, he burned with fire outside the camp, just as the Lord had instructed Moses.

verses.kjv: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.decoded: Then Moses presented the ram intended for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons placed their hands on the ram's head.

verses.kjv: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.decoded: And he slaughtered it; and Moses sprinkled the blood all around the altar.

verses.kjv: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
verses.decoded: Then he cut the ram into separate parts; and Moses burned the head, along with the other parts, and the fat.

verses.kjv: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And he washed the internal organs and the legs with water; and Moses burned the entire ram on the altar: it was a burnt offering that produced a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.decoded: Then he brought forward the second ram, which was the ram for the ordination ceremony, and Aaron and his sons placed their hands on the ram's head.

verses.kjv: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
verses.decoded: Then he slaughtered it; and Moses took some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron's right ear, on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

verses.kjv: And he brought Aaron’s sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.decoded: Then he brought Aaron's sons forward, and Moses applied some of the blood to the lobe of their right ear, to the thumbs of their right hands, and to the big toes of their right feet. Moses also sprinkled the remaining blood around the altar.

verses.kjv: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:
verses.decoded: Then he took the fat, including the fatty tail, all the fat covering the internal organs, the fatty membrane above the liver, and both kidneys with their fat, along with the right thigh. Moses then took these items from the altars and burned them on the altar as a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, a sacrifice made by fire to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:
verses.decoded: And from the basket of unleavened bread that was placed before the Lord, he took one flat, unleavened cake, one cake made with oil, and one thin wafer, and he placed these items on the fat and on the right thigh.

verses.kjv: And he put all upon Aaron’s hands, and upon his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.decoded: And he placed all of these items into Aaron's hands and into his sons' hands, and presented them as a wave offering before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: Then Moses took these items from their hands and burned them on the altar, on top of the burnt offering. These were dedicated offerings, producing a pleasing aroma; it is an offering made by fire to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD: for of the ram of consecration it was Moses’ part; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: Moses took the chest portion and presented it as a wave offering before the Lord, because it was Moses' designated portion from the ram of ordination, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons’ garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
verses.decoded: Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood that was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, on his sons, and on his sons' garments who were with him. In this way, he consecrated Aaron, his garments, his sons, and his sons' garments who were with him.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
verses.decoded: Then Moses said to Aaron and his sons, 'Boil the meat at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, and eat it there with the bread from the basket of consecration offerings, just as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons are to eat it.'

verses.kjv: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.
verses.decoded: And whatever is left over from the meat and the bread, you must burn with fire.

verses.kjv: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.
verses.decoded: And you shall not go out from the entrance of the tent of meeting for seven days, until the period of your dedication is completed; for he will dedicate you for seven days.

verses.kjv: As he hath done this day, so the LORD hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.
verses.decoded: As he has done today, so the Lord has commanded to do, to make purification for you.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.
verses.decoded: For this reason, you must remain at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting continuously for seven days, day and night, and diligently perform the duties commanded by the Lord, to avoid death, because I have been commanded to instruct you thus.

verses.kjv: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.decoded: Therefore, Aaron and his sons carried out everything that the Lord had instructed through Moses.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
verses.decoded: On the eighth day, Moses summoned Aaron, his sons, and the elders of Israel.

verses.kjv: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the LORD.
verses.decoded: He then instructed Aaron, 'Take a young bull for a purification offering and a ram for a whole burnt offering, both without any defect, and present them before the Lord.'

verses.kjv: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;
verses.decoded: And you shall speak to the Israelites, saying, 'Take a young goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both one year old and without defect, for a burnt offering.'

verses.kjv: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the LORD will appear unto you.
verses.decoded: Additionally, a young bull and a male sheep are to be brought as fellowship offerings, to be sacrificed in the presence of the Lord; and a grain offering mixed with olive oil, because today the Lord will reveal himself to you.

verses.kjv: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.
verses.decoded: And they brought what Moses had commanded to the front of the Tent of Meeting where the community gathered; and the entire community approached and stood in the presence of the Lord.

verses.kjv: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the LORD shall appear unto you.
verses.decoded: Then Moses said, 'This is what the Lord has commanded you to do, and the Lord's glory will appear to you.'

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the LORD commanded.
verses.decoded: Then Moses instructed Aaron, "Approach the altar and present your offering for sin and your burnt offering. Perform the ritual of atonement for yourself and for the people. Afterward, present the people's offering and perform the ritual of atonement for them, just as the LORD has commanded."

verses.kjv: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
verses.decoded: So Aaron approached the altar and killed the calf that was designated as a sin offering for himself.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:
verses.decoded: Then Aaron's sons brought the blood to him. He dipped his finger in the blood and put some of it on the projections of the altar, and he poured the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

verses.kjv: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: However, the fat, the kidneys, and the fatty membrane covering the liver from the sin offering, he burned on the altar, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.
verses.decoded: He burned the animal's flesh and hide with fire outside the camp.

verses.kjv: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.
verses.decoded: He slaughtered the animal for the burnt offering, and Aaron's sons brought him the blood, which he splattered all around the altar.

verses.kjv: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.
verses.decoded: Then they brought the burnt offering to him, along with its cut pieces and its head, and he burned them on the altar.

verses.kjv: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.
verses.decoded: And he washed the internal organs and the legs, and burned them on top of the burnt offering on the altar.

verses.kjv: And he brought the people’s offering, and took the goat, which was the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.
verses.decoded: Then he presented the offering for the people. He took the goat, which was designated as the sin offering for the people, killed it, and presented it as a sacrifice for sin, just as he had done with the previous offering.

verses.kjv: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.
verses.decoded: He then presented the burnt offering and sacrificed it as prescribed by the ritual.

verses.kjv: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
verses.decoded: Then he presented the grain offering, and took a portion of it, and burned it on the altar, in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.

verses.kjv: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,
verses.decoded: He also slaughtered the young bull and the ram as a peace offering for the people; and Aaron's sons brought him the blood, which he poured all around the altar.

verses.kjv: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:
verses.decoded: And the fat from the young bull and the ram, including the fatty tail, the fat covering the internal organs, the kidneys, and the fatty membrane over the liver.
