verses.kjv: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:
verses.decoded: And they placed the fatty portions on the chest pieces, and he incinerated these fatty portions on the altar.

verses.kjv: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the LORD; as Moses commanded.
verses.decoded: Aaron presented the breasts and the right shoulder as a wave offering before God, just as Moses had instructed.

verses.kjv: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.
verses.decoded: Aaron raised his hand toward the people and blessed them, and then descended after presenting the sin offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.

verses.kjv: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the people.
verses.decoded: Then Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came out, they blessed the people, and the glorious presence of the Lord appeared to everyone.

verses.kjv: And there came a fire out from before the LORD, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
verses.decoded: Then fire emerged from the presence of the Lord and consumed the burnt offering and the fat on the altar. When all the people witnessed this, they shouted and prostrated themselves.

verses.kjv: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.
verses.decoded: Nadab and Abihu, who were Aaron's sons, each took his own censer, put fire in it, placed incense on top of the fire, and presented unauthorized fire before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And there went out fire from the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.
verses.decoded: Then fire came out from the Lord, and it consumed them, and they died in the Lord's presence.

verses.kjv: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that the LORD spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.
verses.decoded: Then Moses said to Aaron, "This is what the LORD declared: 'I will be treated as holy by those who approach me, and I will be honored before all the people.'"

verses.kjv: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
verses.decoded: Moses summoned Mishael and Elzaphan, who were the sons of Uzziel, Aaron's uncle, and instructed them to approach and carry their relatives from in front of the sanctuary to outside the camp.

verses.kjv: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.
verses.decoded: So they approached and carried them in their tunics out of the camp, just as Moses had instructed.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD hath kindled.
verses.decoded: And Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons, 'Do not dishevel your hair nor tear your clothes; otherwise you will die, and so that wrath does not come upon all the people. Instead, let your relatives, the entire house of Israel, mourn the destruction by fire which the LORD has caused.'

verses.kjv: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the LORD is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.
verses.decoded: And you must not leave the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, otherwise you will die, because the Lord's anointing oil is on you.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Aaron, saying,

verses.kjv: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:
verses.decoded: You and your sons must not drink wine or strong alcoholic beverages when you enter the Tent of Meeting, so that you do not die. This is a permanent law for you and your descendants.

verses.kjv: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;
verses.decoded: So that you may distinguish between what is sacred and what is common, and between what is ritually impure and what is ritually pure.

verses.kjv: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.
verses.decoded: And so that you may teach the Israelites all the laws which the Lord has spoken to them through Moses.

verses.kjv: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it is most holy:
verses.decoded: Then Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and Ithamar, his remaining sons, "Take the grain offering that is left over from the LORD's offerings made by fire, and eat it without yeast beside the altar, because it is extremely holy."

verses.kjv: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons’ due, of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire: for so I am commanded.
verses.decoded: And you shall eat it in the holy place, because it is your rightful portion, and your sons' rightful portion, from the sacrifices made to the Lord by fire; for I have been commanded to do so.

verses.kjv: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they be thy due, and thy sons’ due, which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: You and your sons and daughters may eat the breast that was waved and the thigh that was lifted up in a ritually clean place, because these are your rightful portions and your sons' rightful portions, given from the sacrifices of peace offerings.

verses.kjv: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD; and it shall be thine, and thy sons’ with thee, by a statute for ever; as the LORD hath commanded.
verses.decoded: They are to bring the elevated portion of the shoulder and the presented portion of the breast along with the fat from the offerings made by fire. They shall present these as a special offering before the LORD. These portions will belong to you and your sons permanently, as the LORD has commanded.

verses.kjv: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron which were left alive, saying,
verses.decoded: Moses carefully looked for the goat that was designated for the sin offering and observed that it had been completely burned; consequently, he became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, who were Aaron's sons.

verses.kjv: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it is most holy, and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?
verses.decoded: Why have you not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, considering it is extremely sacred, and God has given it to you to carry the guilt of the community, to make reconciliation for them before the LORD?

verses.kjv: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as I commanded.
verses.decoded: Indeed, its blood was not brought into the holy place; you were certainly supposed to eat it in the holy place, as I commanded.

verses.kjv: And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things have befallen me: and if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the LORD?
verses.decoded: Then Aaron said to Moses, "Look, today they presented their sin offering and their burnt offering before the Lord; yet, despite this, such misfortunes have happened to me: and..."

verses.kjv: And when Moses heard that, he was content.
verses.decoded: And when Moses heard that, he was satisfied.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.
verses.decoded: Tell the people of Israel that these are the animals you may eat from all the animals that live on the earth.

verses.kjv: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.
verses.decoded: Any animal that has a divided hoof, and has completely split hooves, and chews its cud, among the land animals, you may eat.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
verses.decoded: However, you must not eat animals that only chew the cud or only have divided hooves. For example, the camel chews the cud but does not have divided hooves; therefore, it is unclean for you.

verses.kjv: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
verses.decoded: The rock badger is unclean for you because, although it chews the cud, it does not have divided hooves.

verses.kjv: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
verses.decoded: The hare is considered unclean for you because, although it chews its cud, it does not have divided hooves.

verses.kjv: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you.
verses.decoded: Even though the pig has divided hooves and cloven feet, it does not chew the cud; therefore, it is unclean for you.

verses.kjv: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they are unclean to you.
verses.decoded: You must not eat their meat, and you must not touch their dead bodies; they are ritually unclean for you.

verses.kjv: These shall ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.
verses.decoded: You may eat any creature from the water that has fins and scales, whether it lives in the seas or in the rivers.

verses.kjv: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which is in the waters, they shall be an abomination unto you:
verses.decoded: And all creatures in the seas and rivers that do not have fins and scales, among all the moving creatures in the water, and any living thing that is in the water,

verses.kjv: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.
verses.decoded: They will be detestable to you; you must not eat their meat, but you must consider their dead bodies detestable.

verses.kjv: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that shall be an abomination unto you.
verses.decoded: Anything in the water that does not have fins or scales is to be considered detestable to you.

verses.kjv: And these are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
verses.decoded: And these are the birds that you must consider detestable; they must not be eaten, for they are an abhorrence: the eagle, the ossifrage, and the osprey.

verses.kjv: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;
verses.decoded: And the vulture, and the kite, each according to its species.

verses.kjv: Every raven after his kind;
verses.decoded: Every raven according to its species;

verses.kjv: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
verses.decoded: Also the owl, and the nighthawk, and the cuckoo, and all kinds of hawks,

verses.kjv: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,
verses.decoded: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,

verses.kjv: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,
verses.decoded: Also the swan, the pelican, and the vulture,

verses.kjv: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
verses.decoded: And the stork, the heron and its various types, the lapwing, and the bat.

verses.kjv: All fowls that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination unto you.
verses.decoded: All winged insects that move by crawling on four legs are to be considered detestable to you.

verses.kjv: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;
verses.decoded: However, you may eat from every winged insect that moves on all four legs, which has jointed legs above its feet for leaping on the ground.

verses.kjv: Even these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.
verses.decoded: Among them, you may eat these: the locust according to its kind, the bald locust according to its kind, the beetle according to its kind, and the grasshopper according to its kind.

verses.kjv: But all other flying creeping things, which have four feet, shall be an abomination unto you.
verses.decoded: However, all other winged insects that move by crawling or swarming, which have four legs, are to be considered detestable to you.

verses.kjv: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: And because of these, you will become ritually unclean; anyone who touches their dead bodies will be ritually unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: And anyone who carries any part of their dead body must wash their clothes and will be ritually unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.
verses.decoded: The dead bodies of every animal that has divided hooves but does not have completely split hooves, nor chews the cud, are ritually unclean for you; anyone who touches them will become ritually unclean.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: Any animal that walks on its paws, among all the various kinds of four-footed animals, is considered unclean for you. Whoever touches their dead body will be unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.
verses.decoded: And anyone who carries their dead body must wash his clothes and will be ritually unclean until the evening; these animals are considered unclean for you.

verses.kjv: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,
verses.decoded: Among the small creatures that move along the ground, these are also considered unclean for you: the weasel, the mouse, and all kinds of lizards.

verses.kjv: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.
verses.decoded: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.

verses.kjv: These are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: These creatures are considered impure for you among all the animals that move along the ground. Anyone who touches their dead bodies will be considered ritually impure until evening.

verses.kjv: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.
verses.decoded: If any of these dead animals falls on something, that item will become ritually unclean. This applies whether the item is a wooden utensil, clothing, an animal skin, or a sack.

verses.kjv: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.
verses.decoded: And any clay pot into which any of these creatures falls, whatever is inside it will become unclean, and you must break it.

verses.kjv: Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.
verses.decoded: Any edible food that comes into contact with water from an unclean source will become ritually impure. Similarly, any drink in a vessel that has become ritually impure will also be considered ritually impure.

verses.kjv: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.
verses.decoded: And anything upon which any part of their dead body falls will become ritually impure; whether it is an oven or a cooking stove, these items must be broken apart, because they are impure and will remain impure for you.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.
verses.decoded: However, a spring or a cistern that contains an abundance of water will remain ritually pure. But anything that touches the dead body of such an animal will become ritually impure.

verses.kjv: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.
verses.decoded: And if any part of their dead body falls upon any seed that is meant to be planted, it will be considered clean.

verses.kjv: But if any water be put upon the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.
verses.decoded: However, if any water is placed on the seed, and any part of the carcass of an unclean animal falls on that watered seed, then it will be considered unclean for you.

verses.kjv: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: If any animal that you are permitted to eat dies naturally, anyone who touches its dead body will be considered ritually impure until the evening.

verses.kjv: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: And anyone who eats from its carcass must wash their clothes and will remain ritually unclean until evening. Similarly, anyone who carries its carcass must wash their clothes and will remain ritually unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
verses.decoded: Every small creature that crawls or creeps along the ground is considered detestable; it must not be eaten.

verses.kjv: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
verses.decoded: You must not eat any creature that moves on its belly, or any that walks on four legs, or any that has many feet among all the swarming creatures that move on the earth; for they are detestable.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
verses.decoded: You must not make yourselves detestable with any creature that crawls on the ground, nor should you make yourselves impure with them, so that you become defiled by them.

verses.kjv: For I am the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verses.decoded: Because I am the Lord your God, you must therefore make yourselves sacred and be holy, because I am holy. You must not make yourselves unclean with any kind of creature that moves along the ground.

verses.kjv: For I am the LORD that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
verses.decoded: Because I am the LORD who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God, therefore, you must be holy because I am holy.

verses.kjv: This is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:
verses.decoded: This is the regulation concerning land animals, birds, all living creatures that move in the water, and all creatures that crawl on the ground.

verses.kjv: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.
verses.decoded: To distinguish between what is ritually impure and what is pure, and between animals that may be eaten and animals that may not be eaten.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.
verses.decoded: Tell the people of Israel: If a woman becomes pregnant and gives birth to a male child, then she will be ritually unclean for seven days, just as she is unclean during her monthly period.

verses.kjv: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
verses.decoded: And on the eighth day, the skin covering the tip of his penis must be removed.

verses.kjv: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.
verses.decoded: Then she must remain in the state of her ritual cleansing for thirty-three days. She must not touch anything consecrated or enter the sanctuary until the days of her purification are completed.

verses.kjv: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.
verses.decoded: But if she gives birth to a female child, then she will be ritually unclean for two weeks, just as she is during her menstrual period; and she must remain in the blood of her purification for sixty-six days.

verses.kjv: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:
verses.decoded: And when the period of her ritual purification is completed, whether for a son or for a daughter, she must bring a one-year-old lamb as a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtledove as a sin offering, to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, to the priest.

verses.kjv: Who shall offer it before the LORD, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female.
verses.decoded: The priest will present it before the Lord and perform a ritual of atonement for her, and she will be purified from her discharge of blood.

verses.kjv: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.
verses.decoded: But if she cannot afford a lamb, she must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons; one for a burnt offering and the other for a sin offering. The priest will then perform the atonement ritual for her, and she will be declared clean.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

verses.kjv: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:
verses.decoded: When a person has on their skin a swelling, a sore, or a discolored patch, and it appears to be a serious skin disease; then

verses.kjv: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
verses.decoded: The priest will examine the affected area on the person's skin. If the hair within the affliction has turned white, and the affliction appears to be deeper than the surface of the skin, it is a case of leprosy. The priest will then examine the individual and declare them ritually unclean.

verses.kjv: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days:
verses.decoded: If the discolored area on the skin of a person's body appears white, and visually does not seem to be deeper than the surface of the skin, and the hair on that area has not turned white, then the priest must isolate that person for seven days.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague in his sight be at a stay, and the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:
verses.decoded: On the seventh day, the priest will examine the person. If the skin disease appears to have stopped spreading and has not spread further on the skin, then the priest will declare the person clean. It is only a temporary skin irritation. The person must then wash their clothes and will be considered clean.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague be somewhat dark, and the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is but a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.decoded: Then the priest will examine the person again on the seventh day. If the affected area has faded slightly and has not spread on the skin, the priest will declare the person clean. It is only a scab, and the person must wash their clothes and will then be clean.

verses.kjv: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again:
verses.decoded: However, if the skin lesion has spread significantly on the skin, after the individual has already been examined by the priest for a declaration of ritual purity, that person must be examined by the priest again.

verses.kjv: And if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a leprosy.
verses.decoded: If the priest observes that the sore is spreading on the skin, then the priest must declare the person ritually unclean; it is a serious skin disease.

verses.kjv: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;
verses.decoded: If a man has a severe skin disease, he must be brought to the priest.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the rising be white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising;
verses.decoded: The priest will examine the person, and if the swelling on the skin is white, and the hair in that area has turned white, and there is raw, inflamed flesh within the swelling.

verses.kjv: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he is unclean.
verses.decoded: If it is a chronic skin disease on his skin, the priest must declare him ritually impure and should not quarantine him, because he is already ritually impure.

verses.kjv: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;
verses.decoded: If the skin disease spreads widely on the skin, and the disease covers all the skin of the person who has the affliction, from their head to their foot,

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.
verses.decoded: Then the priest will examine it, and if the skin disease has covered his entire body, he will declare the afflicted person clean, because it has all turned white.

verses.kjv: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.
verses.decoded: But when unhealed flesh appears on him, he will be declared ritually unclean.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: for the raw flesh is unclean: it is a leprosy.
verses.decoded: The priest will observe the exposed, inflamed skin and declare the individual ritually impure, because the exposed, inflamed skin is impure; it is a serious skin condition.

verses.kjv: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;
verses.decoded: However, if the raw skin lesion returns to its original state and turns white, the person must present himself to the priest.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the plague be turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: he is clean.
verses.decoded: The priest will examine the person, and if the affected area has turned white, then the priest will declare the person who has the skin disease to be clean; the person is clean.

verses.kjv: The flesh also, in which, even in the skin thereof, was a boil, and is healed,
verses.decoded: If a person's skin had a boil that has since healed,

verses.kjv: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;
verses.decoded: And if, in the area where the boil was, there appears a white raised area, or a distinct white spot with a reddish tint, it must be shown to the priest.

verses.kjv: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it be in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.
verses.decoded: And if, when the priest examines it, and indeed it appears to be deeper than the skin, and the hair on it has turned white, the priest must declare that person unclean; it is a serious skin disease.

verses.kjv: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and if it be not lower than the skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
verses.decoded: However, if the priest examines it and observes no white hairs within it, and if it is not deeper than the surrounding skin, but appears somewhat dark; then the priest must isolate the individual for seven days.

verses.kjv: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.
verses.decoded: And if it spreads extensively on the skin, then the priest must declare the person ritually unclean, because it is a serious skin disease.

verses.kjv: But if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not, it is a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.decoded: However, if the discolored patch remains in its original location and does not spread, it is merely the scar of a healed inflammation; and the priest is to declare the individual ritually clean.

verses.kjv: Or if there be any flesh, in the skin whereof there is a hot burning, and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;
verses.decoded: If a person has a burn on their skin, and the living tissue affected by the burn develops a bright white spot that is somewhat reddish or entirely white,

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it be in sight deeper than the skin; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
verses.decoded: Then the priest must examine it. If the hair in the affected area has turned white, and the spot appears to be deeper than the surrounding skin, it is a skin disease that has developed from a burn.

verses.kjv: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the other skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
verses.decoded: However, if the priest examines the affected area and finds no white hair within the bright spot, and the spot is not deeper than the surrounding skin, but rather appears somewhat faded;

verses.kjv: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: and if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
verses.decoded: And on the seventh day, the priest will examine the person. If the affliction has spread extensively on the skin, then the priest will declare the person ritually unclean, for it is a severe skin disease.

verses.kjv: And if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not in the skin, but it be somewhat dark; it is a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is an inflammation of the burning.
verses.decoded: And if the bright spot remains in its original location and does not spread on the skin, but appears somewhat faded or dull, it is a swelling caused by a burn, and the priest must declare the person ritually clean.

verses.kjv: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;
verses.decoded: If a man or a woman has a skin disease on the head or in the beard,

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it be in sight deeper than the skin; and there be in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a dry scall, even a leprosy upon the head or beard.
verses.decoded: Then the priest will examine the affected area. If it appears to be deeper than the surface of the skin, and there is fine, yellowish hair within it, then the priest must declare the person ritually unclean.

verses.kjv: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it be not in sight deeper than the skin, and that there is no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days:
verses.decoded: If the priest examines the affected area of the scalp, and observes that it does not appear to be deeper than the surface of the skin, and there is no black hair within it, then the priest must isolate the person with the scalp condition for seven days.

verses.kjv: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, if the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin;
verses.decoded: On the seventh day, the priest will examine the affected area. If the skin lesion has not spread, and there is no yellow hair within it, and the lesion does not appear to be deeper than the surface of the skin,

verses.kjv: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more:
verses.decoded: The person must shave, but he must not shave the affected area; and the priest must isolate the person with the affected area for seven more days.

verses.kjv: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, nor be in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.decoded: On the seventh day, the priest will examine the skin lesion. If the lesion has not spread on the skin and does not appear to be deeper than the surface of the skin,

verses.kjv: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;
verses.decoded: However, if the skin infection spreads significantly after the person has been declared clean;

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he is unclean.
verses.decoded: Then the priest will examine the person; and if it is evident that the skin lesion has spread on the skin, the priest should not look for yellow hair, because the person is ritually unclean.

verses.kjv: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and that there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.decoded: But if the skin infection remains unchanged in his appearance, and black hair has grown within it, then the skin infection is healed, and he is ritually clean. The priest must then declare him clean.

verses.kjv: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;
verses.decoded: If a man or a woman has bright spots, specifically white bright spots, on the skin of their body;

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin; he is clean.
verses.decoded: Then the priest will examine it: and, if the bright spots on their skin are dull white, it is a harmless rash that has appeared on the skin; the person is clean.

verses.kjv: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.
verses.decoded: If a man's hair has fallen out from his head, he is bald, but he is still clean.

verses.kjv: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he is forehead bald: yet is he clean.
verses.decoded: And the man whose hair has fallen out from the front part of his head, making him bald on his forehead, is nevertheless considered clean.

verses.kjv: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
verses.decoded: If a white or reddish sore appears on a bald head or a bald forehead, it is a skin disease that has broken out on that bald head or bald forehead.

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;
verses.decoded: Then the priest must examine it: and observe, if the raised area of the infection is reddish-white on his bald scalp, or on his bald forehead, resembling a skin disease.

verses.kjv: He is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague is in his head.
verses.decoded: He is a man with a severe skin disease; he is ritually impure. The priest must declare him completely impure; the affliction is on his head.

verses.kjv: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.
verses.decoded: The person afflicted with the skin disease must have torn clothes, an uncovered head, and must cover their upper lip, and they shall call out, 'Unclean, unclean!'

verses.kjv: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his habitation be.
verses.decoded: Throughout the entire period that the infectious disease is present in him, he will be considered ritually impure; he is unclean. He must live in isolation, and his dwelling place shall be outside the community camp.

verses.kjv: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;
verses.decoded: If a garment has a spreading skin disease, whether it is a wool garment or a linen garment;

verses.kjv: Whether it be in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;
verses.decoded: Whether it is in the lengthwise threads or the crosswise threads of a fabric, made of linen or wool, or in leather, or in any item made of leather.

verses.kjv: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:
verses.decoded: If the affected area is greenish or reddish in the clothing, or in the leather, whether in the lengthwise threads or the crosswise threads of the fabric, or in any kind of leather item, it is a spreading contamination.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up it that hath the plague seven days:
verses.decoded: The priest will examine the affected area or item and isolate the one with the affliction for seven days.

verses.kjv: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, or in any work that is made of skin; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.
verses.decoded: On the seventh day, the priest must examine the affected area. If the contamination has spread in the garment, whether in the lengthwise threads, or in the crosswise threads, or in a piece of leather, or in any item made of leather,

verses.kjv: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.decoded: Therefore, he must burn that garment, whether it is made of woven threads (warp or woof), wool, linen, or any item made of animal skin, in which the infectious skin disease is present, because it is a persistent and spreading skin disease.

verses.kjv: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;
verses.decoded: And if the priest examines it, and indeed the contamination has not spread in the garment, whether in the warp threads, or in the weft threads, or in any item made of leather;

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more:
verses.decoded: Then the priest will order that the item containing the infection be washed, and he will isolate it for an additional seven days.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, if the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it is fret inward, whether it be bare within or without.
verses.decoded: And the priest will examine the affected area after it has been washed. If the affected area has not changed its color and has not spread, it is still considered unclean. You must burn it in the fire, because the damage has eaten deeply into the material, whether the affected part is on the inside or the outside.

verses.kjv: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:
verses.decoded: If the priest examines it and sees that the affected area is still somewhat dark after it has been washed, then he must tear that part out of the garment, or out of the leather, or out of the warp (lengthwise threads), or out of the woof (crosswise threads).

verses.kjv: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a spreading plague: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.
verses.decoded: But if it still appears in the clothing, whether in the lengthwise threads or the crosswise threads, or in any leather item, it is a spreading contamination; you must burn the item.

verses.kjv: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.
verses.decoded: And if it is a clothing item, whether made of woven fabric (warp or woof) or any item made of animal skin, which you must wash, if the contamination has disappeared from them, then it must be washed a second time, and it will be clean.

verses.kjv: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
verses.decoded: This is the regulation concerning the infectious skin disease in a garment made of wool or linen, whether in the woven threads (warp) or the crosswise threads (woof), or in any item made of animal skins, for declaring it ritually clean or for declaring it ritually unclean.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:
verses.decoded: This is the instruction for a person with a severe skin disease on the day of their purification: they are to be brought to the priest.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;
verses.decoded: The priest will then go outside the camp and examine the person to see if the skin disease (leprosy) has been cured in the afflicted individual.

verses.kjv: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
verses.decoded: Then the priest will command that for the person who is to be purified, two living and ritually clean birds, along with cedar wood, scarlet material, and hyssop, be taken.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:
verses.decoded: The priest is to instruct that one of the birds be slaughtered in a clay pot over fresh, flowing water.

verses.kjv: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:
verses.decoded: Regarding the live bird, he must take it, along with the cedar wood, the scarlet material, and the hyssop plant. He will then dip these items and the live bird into the blood of the bird that was slaughtered over fresh, flowing water.

verses.kjv: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.
verses.decoded: And the priest must sprinkle the person who is to be purified from the skin disease seven times, and then declare that person clean. After that, the priest must release the living bird into the open countryside.

verses.kjv: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.
verses.decoded: The person who is to be purified must wash his clothes, shave off all his body hair, and bathe himself in water, so that he may be considered clean. After that, he may enter the camp.

verses.kjv: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
verses.decoded: However, on the seventh day, he must shave off all the hair from his head, his beard, and his eyebrows; indeed, he must shave off all his hair. Then he must wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and he will be clean.

verses.kjv: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.
verses.decoded: On the eighth day, he is to take two male lambs that are without defect, and one female lamb that is one year old and without defect, along with three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a grain offering, and one log of olive oil.

verses.kjv: And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the LORD, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.decoded: Then the priest who performs the cleansing ritual for the individual shall bring the person who is to be cleansed, along with the required offerings, before the Lord at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD:
verses.decoded: And the priest is to take one male lamb and present it as a guilt offering, along with a log of oil, and perform the wave offering ritual with them before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering: it is most holy:
verses.decoded: And he must slaughter the lamb in the same location where he slaughters the purification offering and the burnt offering, in the sacred area; because just as the purification offering belongs to the priest, so does the restitution offering.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
verses.decoded: The priest will take some of the blood from the guilt offering and put it on the lobe of the right ear of the person who is to be purified, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand:
verses.decoded: The priest is to take some of the measure of oil and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD:
verses.decoded: The priest will dip his right index finger into the oil held in his left hand and then sprinkle some of that oil seven times in the presence of the Lord.

verses.kjv: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:
verses.decoded: And from the remaining oil in his hand, the priest shall apply it to the lobe of the right ear of the person being purified, and to the thumb of their right hand, and to the big toe of their right foot, on the same places where the blood of the guilt offering was applied.

verses.kjv: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD.
verses.decoded: The priest will then pour the remaining oil from his hand onto the head of the person who is being purified. In this way, the priest will perform a ritual of atonement for that person before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:
verses.decoded: Then the priest must present the sin offering and perform a ritual of purification for the person who is to be cleansed from their impurity; and after that, the priest must slaughter the animal for the burnt offering.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
verses.decoded: The priest will present the burnt offering and the grain offering on the altar. The priest will perform a ritual of atonement for the individual, and then the individual will be declared ritually clean.

verses.kjv: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;
verses.decoded: And if he is poor and cannot afford the full amount, then he shall take one male lamb as a guilt offering to be presented as a wave offering, to make atonement for him, along with one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with olive oil for a grain offering, and one log of olive oil.

verses.kjv: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.
verses.decoded: And two turtledoves or two young pigeons, whichever he can obtain; one of them shall be for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the LORD.
verses.decoded: And on the eighth day, he must bring these offerings to the priest for his purification, at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, in the presence of the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD:
verses.decoded: The priest will take the lamb designated for the guilt offering and a measure of oil, and he will present them with a waving gesture as a special offering before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
verses.decoded: And he must slaughter the lamb designated for the guilt offering, and the priest must take some of the blood from the guilt offering and apply it to the lobe of the right ear of the person being purified, and to the thumb of their right hand, and to the big toe of their right foot.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:
verses.decoded: The priest will then pour some of the oil into the palm of his left hand.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD:
verses.decoded: And the priest will sprinkle some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times using his right finger in the presence of the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:
verses.decoded: And the priest will apply some of the oil that is in his hand onto the lobe of the right ear of the person who is being purified, and onto the thumb of his right hand, and onto the big toe of his right foot, in the same places where the blood of the guilt offering was applied.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the LORD.
verses.decoded: The priest must then apply the remaining oil in his hand to the head of the person being cleansed, in order to make atonement for them before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;
verses.decoded: And he must offer one of the turtledoves or young pigeons, whichever he can afford.

verses.kjv: Even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the LORD.
verses.decoded: Specifically, whatever he can afford, one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering, along with the grain offering. The priest will then perform the ritual of atonement for him before the Lord.

verses.kjv: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing.
verses.decoded: This is the regulation for a person afflicted with a skin disease who cannot afford the full purification offerings.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.kjv: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;
verses.decoded: When you enter the land of Canaan, which I am giving to you as your inherited property, and I inflict a disease, such as mold or mildew, upon a house in the land you possess;

verses.kjv: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house:
verses.decoded: The owner of the house must come and inform the priest, saying, 'It appears to me that there is a diseased condition in the house.'

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go into it to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:
verses.decoded: Then the priest must order that the house be emptied before he enters it to inspect the diseased area, so that everything in the house does not become ceremonially unclean.

verses.kjv: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight are lower than the wall;
verses.decoded: And he will examine the affected area, and observe if the contamination is present in the walls of the house with sunken streaks, greenish or reddish in color, which appear to be recessed below the surface of the wall and deeper than the surrounding wall;

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:
verses.decoded: Then the priest must go outside the house to its entrance and close off the house for seven days.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;
verses.decoded: The priest will return on the seventh day and inspect it. If the contamination has spread in the walls of the house,

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is, and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:
verses.decoded: Then the priest is to issue an order for the removal of the stones that are affected by the contamination, and these stones are to be discarded in a designated unclean area outside the city.

verses.kjv: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:
verses.decoded: And he must have the inside of the house scraped all around, and they must pour the dust that they scrape off outside the city into an unclean place.

verses.kjv: And they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house.
verses.decoded: And they will take different stones and put them in the place of those stones; and he will take different mortar and will plaster the house.

verses.kjv: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plaistered;
verses.decoded: If the contamination reappears and spreads within the house, after the stones have been removed, and after the house has been scraped, and after it has been replastered;

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house: it is unclean.
verses.decoded: Then the priest will come and examine it. If the contamination has spread throughout the house, it is a destructive mildew within the house; it is ritually unclean.

verses.kjv: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the morter of the house; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place.
verses.decoded: And he must tear down the house, its stones, and its timber, and all the mortar of the house; and he must carry them out of the city to an unclean place.

verses.kjv: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, anyone who enters the house during the entire period that it is closed off will be ritually unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.
verses.decoded: And anyone who lies down in the house must wash their clothes; and anyone who eats in the house must wash their clothes.

verses.kjv: And if the priest shall come in, and look upon it, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plaistered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.
verses.decoded: But if the priest comes in and examines it, and indeed the contamination has not spread in the house after it was replastered, then the priest must declare the house clean, because the contamination is gone.

verses.kjv: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
verses.decoded: He is to take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop to purify the house.

verses.kjv: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:
verses.decoded: And he must kill one of the birds in a clay pot over fresh, flowing water.

verses.kjv: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:
verses.decoded: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet material, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

verses.kjv: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:
verses.decoded: And he will purify the house with the blood of the bird, and with the flowing water, and with the live bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet yarn.

verses.kjv: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.
verses.decoded: However, he must release the live bird outside the city into the open countryside, and perform a ritual of purification for the house: then it will be considered clean.

verses.kjv: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,
verses.decoded: This is the regulation concerning every kind of affliction involving skin disease, including scaly eruptions.

verses.kjv: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,
verses.decoded: This law also applies to mildew on clothing and in a house,

verses.kjv: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:
verses.decoded: And concerning a swelling, and concerning a scab, and concerning a discolored patch:

verses.kjv: To teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean: this is the law of leprosy.
verses.decoded: To provide instruction on distinguishing between what is ritually impure and what is ritually pure: these are the regulations concerning leprosy.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.
verses.decoded: Tell the people of Israel: When any man has a bodily discharge, he is considered ritually impure because of that discharge.

verses.kjv: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.
verses.decoded: This is how his impurity will be defined concerning his bodily discharge: whether his body has a continuous flow of discharge, or if the flow of his discharge is blocked, it signifies his impurity.

verses.kjv: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.
verses.decoded: Any bed on which a man with a bodily discharge lies is considered ritually impure, and anything on which he sits will also be considered ritually impure.

verses.kjv: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: And anyone who touches his bed must wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and will remain ritually unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And he that sitteth on any thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: And anyone who sits on anything that the man with the discharge sat on must wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and he will remain unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: And anyone who touches the body of a man who has a discharge must wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and will remain ritually unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: And if the man who has a bodily discharge spits on someone who is ritually clean, then that person must wash their clothes and bathe their entire body in water, and remain ritually unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.
verses.decoded: Any saddle that the man with the bodily discharge rides upon will be considered unclean.

verses.kjv: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: And anyone who touches anything that was beneath him will be ceremonially unclean until evening. And anyone who carries any of those items must wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and remain ceremonially unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: And anyone whom the man with the discharge touches, if he has not rinsed his hands in water, that person must wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and he will remain unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
verses.decoded: Any clay pot that the man with the discharge touches must be broken, and every wooden utensil must be rinsed with water.

verses.kjv: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
verses.decoded: And when the man who has a discharge is cured of his discharge, he must count seven days for his purification. Then he must wash his clothes and bathe his body in flowing water, and he will be clean.

verses.kjv: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:
verses.decoded: On the eighth day, he must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, before the LORD, and give them to the priest.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.
verses.decoded: The priest must present these two birds, one as an offering for sin and the other as a burnt offering. In this way, the priest will perform a ritual of purification for the man before the Lord, because of his bodily discharge.

verses.kjv: And if any man’s seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: If a man has an emission of semen, he must then wash his entire body with water and remain ritually unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: Any clothing or animal skin on which there is semen must be washed with water, and will remain ritually unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: The woman also with whom man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: If a man has sexual intercourse with a woman, both of them must wash themselves with water and remain ritually unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: And if a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her body is blood, she must be set apart for seven days; and anyone who touches her will be considered ritually unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
verses.decoded: And everything that she lies on during her time of separation will be unclean; also, everything that she sits on will be unclean.

verses.kjv: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: And anyone who touches her bed must wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and will be considered unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: And anyone who touches anything that she sat on must wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and he will be ritually unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: If it is on her bed, or on anything she sits on, when someone touches it, that person will be ritually unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
verses.decoded: If any man has sexual intercourse with a woman while she is menstruating, he will be ritually unclean for seven days; and any bed on which he lies will also be considered ritually unclean.

verses.kjv: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.
verses.decoded: If a woman has a discharge of blood for many days outside of her regular menstrual period, or if the discharge continues beyond her regular menstrual period, then all the days of her unclean discharge will be considered the same as the days of her menstrual period: she will be ritually unclean.

verses.kjv: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.
verses.decoded: Any bed on which she lies throughout the days of her discharge will be considered unclean, just like the bed she uses during her period of ritual impurity; and anything she sits on will also be considered unclean.

verses.kjv: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: Anyone who touches those items will become ritually impure; they must wash their clothes and bathe themselves in water, and they will remain impure until evening.

verses.kjv: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
verses.decoded: But if her discharge has stopped, then she must count seven days for herself, and after that, she will be clean.

verses.kjv: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: And on the eighth day, she is to take two turtledoves or two young pigeons for herself, and bring them to the priest at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the LORD for the issue of her uncleanness.
verses.decoded: The priest is to present one animal as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. Through these actions, the priest will perform a ritual of purification for her before the Lord.

verses.kjv: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.
verses.decoded: In this way, you must keep the Israelites separate from their ritual impurity, so that they do not die because of their impurity when they defile my sacred tent that is present among them.

verses.kjv: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;
verses.decoded: This is the regulation for a man who has a bodily discharge, and for a man who has an emission of semen, and who consequently becomes ritually unclean.

verses.kjv: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
verses.decoded: This also applies to a woman during her menstrual period, and to a man who has a bodily discharge, and to a woman who has a bodily discharge, and to a man who has sexual relations with a woman who is ritually unclean.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;
verses.decoded: The Lord spoke to Moses after the death of Aaron's two sons, who died when they presented an offering before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to Moses, 'Tell your brother Aaron that he should not enter the holy place inside the curtain in front of the atonement cover whenever he wishes, so that he does not die; because I will appear in the cloud above the atonement cover.'

verses.kjv: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.decoded: This is how Aaron is to enter the holy place: he must bring a young bull as an offering for sin, and a ram as a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and so put them on.
verses.decoded: He must wear the sacred linen tunic, and he must have the linen undergarments on his body. He shall be fastened with a linen sash, and he shall be dressed with the linen turban. These are sacred clothes; therefore, he must wash his body with water and then put them on.

verses.kjv: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
verses.decoded: And he is to take from the assembly of the people of Israel two young male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.
verses.decoded: Aaron will present his young bull as a sin offering for himself, and he will perform a ritual of atonement for himself and for his household.

verses.kjv: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: Then he is to take the two goats and present them before the Lord at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
verses.decoded: Aaron will cast lots for the two goats; one lot will be for the Lord, and the other lot will be for the scapegoat.
