verses.kjv: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD’s lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.
verses.decoded: And Aaron is to present the goat upon which the Lord's designated portion landed, and sacrifice it as an offering for sin.

verses.kjv: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.
verses.decoded: However, the goat that was chosen by lot to be the scapegoat must be presented alive before the Lord, in order to perform a ritual of purification with it, and then to release it.

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:
verses.decoded: Aaron is to present the young bull for the purification offering, which is for himself. He will then perform the ritual of atonement for himself and for his household, and he will slaughter the young bull designated for his own purification offering.

verses.kjv: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the vail:
verses.decoded: And he must take a censer filled with burning charcoal from the altar that is before the Lord, and his hands full of finely ground fragrant incense, and bring it inside the curtain.

verses.kjv: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:
verses.decoded: He must place the incense on the fire in the presence of the Lord, so that the cloud of smoke from the incense may cover the atonement cover that rests above the tablets of the covenant law, in order that he does not die.

verses.kjv: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.decoded: He must take some of the bull's blood and sprinkle it with his finger towards the east side of the atonement cover; and in front of the atonement cover, he must sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.

verses.kjv: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:
verses.decoded: Then he must kill the goat designated for the sin offering for the people, and bring its blood inside the curtain, and perform the same ritual with that blood as he did with the blood of the bull.

verses.kjv: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
verses.decoded: And he must perform a ritual of purification for the holy sanctuary, due to the impurity of the people of Israel and their wrongdoings in all their sins. He must do the same for the Tent of Meeting, which remains among them despite their impurity.

verses.kjv: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.
verses.decoded: And no one is to be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to perform the ritual of atonement in the Most Holy Place, until he comes out, having completed the atonement for himself, for his family, and for the entire community of Israel.

verses.kjv: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the LORD, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.
verses.decoded: Then he must go out to the altar that stands before the Lord and perform a ritual of purification for it. He will take some of the blood from the young bull and some of the blood from the goat, and he will apply it to the horns all around the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: He is to sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and purify and consecrate it from the impurities of the Israelites.

verses.kjv: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:
verses.decoded: And when he has finished making atonement for the holy place, and the tent of meeting, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat.

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:
verses.decoded: And Aaron will place both his hands on the head of the living goat, and confess over it all the wrongdoings of the people of Israel, and all their rebellions, including all their sins. He will transfer these to the head of the goat, and then send the goat away into the wilderness by means of a suitable man.

verses.kjv: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
verses.decoded: And the goat will carry on itself all their wrongdoings to an uninhabited land; and he will release the goat in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:
verses.decoded: Then Aaron is to enter the Tent of Meeting and remove the linen garments he wore when he went into the Most Holy Place, and he must leave them there.

verses.kjv: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.
verses.decoded: Then he must wash his body with water in the sacred area, and put on his clothes, and come out, and present his burnt offering, and the burnt offering for the people, and perform a ritual to make amends for himself and for the people.

verses.kjv: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.
verses.decoded: He is to burn the fat from the purification offering on the altar.

verses.kjv: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.
verses.decoded: The person who released the goat designated as the scapegoat must wash their clothes and cleanse their body with water; only then may they re-enter the camp.

verses.kjv: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
verses.decoded: The bull and the goat designated for the sin offering, whose blood was brought into the sacred area to perform the ritual of atonement, must be taken outside the camp. Their hides, meat, and waste are then to be burned with fire.

verses.kjv: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
verses.decoded: The person who burns them must wash his clothes and bathe his body in water; afterward, he may come back into the camp.

verses.kjv: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you: that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:
verses.decoded: This will be a permanent law for you: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of that month, you must deny yourselves and do no work at all, whether you are a native-born Israelite or a foreigner living among you.

verses.kjv: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
verses.decoded: Because on that day, the priest will perform a ritual of atonement for you, to purify you, so that you may become pure from all your transgressions in the presence of the Lord.

verses.kjv: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.
verses.decoded: This day will be a complete day of rest for you, and you must humble yourselves; this is a permanent decree.

verses.kjv: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest’s office in his father’s stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, even the holy garments:
verses.decoded: The priest who has been anointed and formally appointed to serve in the priestly role, succeeding his father, will perform the atonement ritual, and he will wear the sacred linen garments.

verses.kjv: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.
verses.decoded: And he will perform a ritual of reconciliation for the sacred sanctuary, and he will perform a ritual of reconciliation for the tent of meeting, and for the altar, and he will perform a ritual of reconciliation for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.

verses.kjv: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: This will be a permanent law for you, to perform a ritual of reconciliation for the people of Israel for all their wrongdoings once a year.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, saying,
verses.decoded: Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the people of Israel, and tell them: This is what the Lord has commanded, saying,

verses.kjv: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it out of the camp,
verses.decoded: Any person from the community of Israel who slaughters an ox, or a lamb, or a goat, either within the camp or outside the camp,

verses.kjv: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:
verses.decoded: And if he does not bring it to the entrance of the tent of meeting to present an offering to the Lord in front of the Lord's tent, that man will be held accountable for bloodshed; he has shed blood, and that man will be separated from his people.

verses.kjv: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them for peace offerings unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: So that the Israelites may bring their sacrifices, which they have been offering in the open field, and bring them to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: The priest is to sprinkle the blood on the altar of the Lord at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and burn the fat as a pleasing aroma to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.
verses.decoded: And they will no longer offer their sacrifices to goat-idols or demons, after which they have pursued spiritual unfaithfulness. This will be a permanent law for them throughout all their future generations.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,
verses.decoded: And you shall say to them: Any person from the community of Israel, or any foreigner residing among you, who presents a burnt offering or sacrifice,

verses.kjv: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the LORD; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.decoded: And if someone does not bring it to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting to present it as an offering to the Lord, that person will be separated from their community.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.decoded: Any person from the community of Israel, or any foreigner living among you, who consumes any kind of blood, I will strongly oppose that individual who eats blood, and I will remove him from his people.

verses.kjv: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.
verses.decoded: Because the life of a living creature is in its blood, I have given it to you to be used on the altar to make reconciliation for your lives; for it is the blood that makes reconciliation for a life.

verses.kjv: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.
verses.decoded: Therefore, I instructed the people of Israel that no individual among them should consume blood, and similarly, no foreigner residing among them should consume blood.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.
verses.decoded: Any person among the Israelites, or any foreigner living among them, who hunts and catches an animal or bird that is permissible to eat, must drain its blood and cover it with dirt.

verses.kjv: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.
verses.decoded: Because the life of every living creature is in its blood, and its blood is essential for its life, I therefore instructed the Israelites that they must not consume the blood of any kind of animal. This is because the life of every living creature is its blood; anyone who consumes it will be excluded from the community.

verses.kjv: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself, or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.
verses.decoded: And anyone who eats an animal that died naturally or one that was killed by wild animals, whether a native-born person or a foreigner, must wash their clothes and bathe themselves in water, and remain ritually unclean until evening; then they will be clean.

verses.kjv: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.decoded: However, if he does not wash them or bathe his body, then he will be held responsible for his wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: Speak to the people of Israel, and tell them, 'I am the Lord your God.'

verses.kjv: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.
verses.decoded: You must not behave according to the customs of the land of Egypt, where you once lived. Nor shall you behave according to the customs of the land of Canaan, to which I am bringing you. You must not follow their practices.

verses.kjv: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: You must obey my laws and keep my decrees, living according to them; I am the Lord your God.

verses.kjv: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: Therefore, you must observe my decrees and my ordinances. If a person practices them, they will live by them. I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: None of you shall approach any close relative to have sexual intercourse with them: I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.decoded: You must not have sexual relations with your father or your mother. She is your mother; you must not have sexual relations with her.

verses.kjv: The nakedness of thy father’s wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father’s nakedness.
verses.decoded: You must not have sexual relations with your father's wife, because she is your father's intimate partner.

verses.kjv: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
verses.decoded: You must not have sexual relations with your sister, whether she is your father's daughter or your mother's daughter, and regardless of whether she was born in your home or elsewhere.

verses.kjv: The nakedness of thy son’s daughter, or of thy daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.
verses.decoded: You must not have sexual relations with your son's daughter or your daughter's daughter; that would be a disgrace to you.

verses.kjv: The nakedness of thy father’s wife’s daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.decoded: You must not have sexual relations with your father's daughter by another wife, who is your half-sister; you must not expose her nakedness.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s sister: she is thy father’s near kinswoman.
verses.decoded: You must not have sexual relations with your father's sister; she is your father's close relative.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister: for she is thy mother’s near kinswoman.
verses.decoded: You shall not have sexual relations with your mother's sister, because she is a close female relative of your mother.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.
verses.decoded: You shall not have sexual relations with your father's brother, nor shall you have sexual relations with his wife, for she is your aunt.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son’s wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.decoded: You must not have sexual relations with your daughter-in-law; she is your son's wife, and you must not have sexual relations with her.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother’s wife: it is thy brother’s nakedness.
verses.decoded: You must not have sexual relations with your brother's wife, because that would be a sexual offense against your brother.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
verses.decoded: You shall not have sexual relations with a woman and her daughter. Nor shall you take her granddaughter (either her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter) to have sexual relations with her, because they are her close relatives; that is a wicked act.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.
verses.decoded: You shall not marry a woman in addition to her sister, as this would cause rivalry between them, by having sexual relations with her while her sister is still alive.

verses.kjv: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.
verses.decoded: Additionally, you must not come near a woman to have sexual relations with her while she is ritually impure due to her menstrual period.

verses.kjv: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour’s wife, to defile thyself with her.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, you must not have sexual intercourse with your neighbor's wife, thereby making yourself impure with her.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: And you shall not allow any of your offspring to be sacrificed by fire to Molech, nor shall you dishonor the name of your God: I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
verses.decoded: You shall not have sexual intercourse with a man as you would with a woman; it is a detestable act.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.
verses.decoded: You must not have sexual intercourse with any animal, making yourself impure by doing so. Nor shall any woman position herself before an animal for sexual activity with it, as this is a perversion.

verses.kjv: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:
verses.decoded: Do not make yourselves unclean by any of these practices, because it is through all these things that the nations I am driving out before you have become defiled.

verses.kjv: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.
verses.decoded: The land has become defiled; therefore, I will bring the consequences of its wrongdoing upon it, and the land itself will expel its inhabitants.

verses.kjv: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:
verses.decoded: Therefore, you must obey my laws and my regulations, and you must not commit any of these detestable acts; this applies to both your own people and to any foreigner who lives among you.

verses.kjv: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)
verses.decoded: Indeed, all these detestable practices were committed by the people who lived in the land before you, and because of this, the land has become impure.

verses.kjv: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.
verses.decoded: So that the land does not expel you also, when you defile it, just as it expelled the nations that were before you.

verses.kjv: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.decoded: Anyone who commits any of these detestable acts, those individuals will be separated from their community.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: Therefore, you must observe my decree, so that you do not practice any of these detestable customs that were practiced before you, and so that you do not make yourselves unclean by them: I am the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God am holy.
verses.decoded: Speak to the entire community of the Israelites and tell them: 'You must be holy, because I, the LORD your God, am holy.'

verses.kjv: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: Each of you must respect his mother and his father, and you must observe my Sabbaths. I am the Lord your God.

verses.kjv: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: Do not turn to idols, nor make for yourselves gods cast from metal. I am the Lord your God.

verses.kjv: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.
verses.decoded: And if you present a peace offering to the Lord, you must do so willingly.

verses.kjv: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.decoded: It must be eaten on the same day you offer it, and on the next day. If any part of it remains until the third day, it must be burned with fire.

verses.kjv: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.
verses.decoded: And if any of it is consumed on the third day, it is considered detestable; it will not be approved.

verses.kjv: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.decoded: Consequently, anyone who consumes it will be held accountable for their wrongdoing, because they have treated the LORD's sacred offering as common or impure; and that individual will be expelled from their community.

verses.kjv: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
verses.decoded: And when you harvest the crops from your land, you must not completely harvest the edges of your field, nor should you collect the leftover stalks after harvesting.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: You must not gather the leftover grapes in your vineyard, nor should you pick every single grape from your vineyard; you must leave them for the poor and for foreigners. I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
verses.decoded: You must not steal, nor act deceptively, nor lie to one another.

verses.kjv: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: You must not swear falsely by my name, nor should you dishonor the name of your God: I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
verses.decoded: You must not cheat your neighbor or steal from him. The wages of a hired worker must not remain with you overnight until the next morning.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: You must not insult a deaf person, nor place an obstacle in the path of a blind person that would cause them to trip. Instead, you must show reverence for your God, for I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.
verses.decoded: You must not act unjustly in legal decisions; you shall not show favoritism to the poor, nor give undue honor to the powerful, but you must judge your fellow person fairly.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: You must not go around spreading gossip among your people, nor should you do anything that endangers your neighbor's life. I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.
verses.decoded: You must not harbor hatred against your fellow person in your heart; you must certainly confront your neighbor, so that you do not allow them to continue in their sin.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: You must not seek revenge, nor hold a grudge against your fellow citizens, but instead, you must love your fellow human being as you love yourself: I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.
verses.decoded: You must obey my laws. You shall not allow your livestock to breed with different kinds of animals. You shall not plant your field with two different kinds of seeds. And you shall not wear clothing made from a mixture of linen and wool.

verses.kjv: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
verses.decoded: If a man has sexual relations with a female slave who is promised to another man, but she has not yet been bought out of slavery or given her freedom, there must be a penalty. She will be punished.

verses.kjv: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.
verses.decoded: And that person must bring his guilt offering to the LORD, to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, specifically a ram as a guilt offering.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.
verses.decoded: The priest will perform a ritual of atonement for him with a ram from the guilt offering before the Lord for the sin he has committed, and the sin he has committed will be forgiven.

verses.kjv: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.
verses.decoded: And when you enter the land and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you must consider its fruit as forbidden. For three years it will be considered forbidden to you; it must not be eaten.

verses.kjv: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD withal.
verses.decoded: However, in the fourth year, all the fruit from it must be dedicated as holy, for the purpose of praising the Lord.

verses.kjv: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: And in the fifth year, you may eat its fruit, so that it may yield an abundant harvest for you: I am the Lord your God.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.
verses.decoded: You must not eat anything that still contains blood. You shall not practice divination, nor shall you engage in fortune-telling or interpreting omens.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
verses.decoded: You shall not shave the hair on the sides of your head, nor shall you disfigure the edges of your beard.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: You must not make any cuts on your body as a sign of mourning for the dead, nor should you put any permanent marks or tattoos on yourselves. I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
verses.decoded: Do not dishonor your daughter by causing her to become a prostitute, so that the land does not become sexually immoral and filled with evil.

verses.kjv: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: You must observe my Sabbaths and show respect for my holy place, for I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: Do not turn to those who consult with spirits of the dead or mediums, nor seek out sorcerers, so that you do not become defiled by their practices. I am the Lord your God.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: You shall stand up in the presence of an elderly person, and show respect for the aged, and revere your God: I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.
verses.decoded: If a foreigner resides temporarily with you in your land, you must not mistreat him.

verses.kjv: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: However, the foreigner who lives among you must be treated as if they were born among you. You must love them as you love yourself, because you yourselves were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
verses.decoded: You must not act unjustly in legal decisions, in measuring length, in weighing goods, or in determining volume.

verses.kjv: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.decoded: You must have accurate scales, accurate weights, an accurate ephah (dry measure), and an accurate hin (liquid measure). I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: Therefore, you must obey all my laws and all my regulations, and you must put them into practice: I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, you must tell the Israelites: Any Israelite or any foreigner residing among the Israelites who gives any of their offspring to Molech must certainly be put to death.

verses.kjv: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
verses.decoded: I will turn my attention against that person and will remove him from his community, because he has given his offspring to Molech, thereby making my holy place impure and dishonoring my sacred name.

verses.kjv: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:
verses.decoded: However, if the people of the land deliberately ignore the man who sacrifices his offspring to Molech, and they do not put him to death,

verses.kjv: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.
verses.decoded: Then I will turn against that man and his family. I will remove him from his people, along with everyone who follows him in spiritual unfaithfulness by worshiping Molech.

verses.kjv: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.decoded: And the person who turns to those who consult spirits of the dead and to sorcerers, engaging in spiritual unfaithfulness by pursuing them, I will strongly oppose that person and will remove him from his community.

verses.kjv: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: Therefore, set yourselves apart as holy and be consecrated, because I am the Lord your God.

verses.kjv: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the LORD which sanctify you.
verses.decoded: You must obey my laws and put them into practice, for I am the Lord who makes you holy.

verses.kjv: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
verses.decoded: Indeed, anyone who curses their father or their mother must certainly be put to death, because they have cursed their father or their mother; their bloodguilt is upon them.

verses.kjv: And the man that committeth adultery with another man’s wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
verses.decoded: If a man commits adultery with another man's wife, specifically with his neighbor's wife, both the man and the woman who committed adultery must certainly be put to death.

verses.kjv: And the man that lieth with his father’s wife hath uncovered his father’s nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.decoded: And the man who has sexual relations with his father's wife has thereby dishonored his father's intimate relationship. Both the man and the woman will certainly be put to death; they are responsible for their own demise.

verses.kjv: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.decoded: If a man has sexual relations with his daughter-in-law, both of them must certainly be put to death. They have committed a morally corrupt act; their bloodguilt is upon them.

verses.kjv: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.decoded: If a man has sexual intercourse with another man, in the same way he would with a woman, both of them have committed a detestable act. They must certainly be put to death; their guilt for this act rests upon them.

verses.kjv: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
verses.decoded: If a man marries both a woman and her mother, this is a depraved act. Both the man and the two women shall be burned with fire, so that such depravity does not exist among you.

verses.kjv: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.
verses.decoded: If a man has sexual intercourse with an animal, he must certainly be executed; and you must also kill the animal.

verses.kjv: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.decoded: If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you must kill both the woman and the animal. They must certainly be executed; they are responsible for their own deaths.

verses.kjv: And if a man shall take his sister, his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.decoded: If a man marries his sister, whether she is his father's daughter or his mother's daughter, and they have sexual relations with each other; this is a shameful act. They must be removed from their community in the presence of their people. He has exposed his sister's nakedness; he will be held responsible for his wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.decoded: If a man has sexual intercourse with a woman during her menstrual period, and exposes her nakedness, he has revealed the source of her menstrual flow, and she has also revealed the source of her blood; both of them will be separated from their community.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister, nor of thy father’s sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.
verses.decoded: And you shall not have sexual relations with your mother's sister or your father's sister, because by doing so, one is having sexual relations with a close relative; they will be held accountable for their transgression.

verses.kjv: And if a man shall lie with his uncle’s wife, he hath uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
verses.decoded: If a man has sexual relations with his uncle's wife, he has dishonored his uncle through this act. They will be held responsible for their sin and will die without children.

verses.kjv: And if a man shall take his brother’s wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless.
verses.decoded: If a man marries his brother's wife, it is an impure act. He has violated his brother's marital privacy, and they will remain childless.

verses.kjv: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.
verses.decoded: Therefore, you must obey all my laws and decrees, and put them into practice, so that the land, where I am bringing you to live, does not expel you.

verses.kjv: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
verses.decoded: And you must not follow the practices of the nation that I am driving out before you, because they did all these things, and for that reason, I detested them.

verses.kjv: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I am the LORD your God, which have separated you from other people.
verses.decoded: However, I have told you that you will take possession of their land, and I will give it to you to own—a land that is abundant with milk and honey. I am the Lord your God.

verses.kjv: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.
verses.decoded: Therefore, you must distinguish between clean animals and unclean, and between unclean birds and clean. You must not make yourselves detestable through contact with animals.

verses.kjv: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the LORD am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.
verses.decoded: And you shall be holy to me, because I, the LORD, am holy, and I have separated you from other peoples, so that you may be mine.

verses.kjv: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.
verses.decoded: Any man or woman who is a medium or a sorcerer must certainly be put to death. They are to be killed by stoning; their guilt for their own death rests upon them.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:
verses.decoded: The Lord instructed Moses to tell the priests, who are the descendants of Aaron, that none of them should become ritually impure by coming into contact with a dead person among their community.

verses.kjv: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,
verses.decoded: However, for his close relatives, specifically, for his mother, father, son, daughter, and brother.

verses.kjv: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.
verses.decoded: And for his virgin sister, who is closely related to him and has never been married, he may become ritually unclean.

verses.kjv: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
verses.decoded: However, he must not make himself ritually unclean, because he is a leader among his people, thereby desecrating himself.

verses.kjv: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
verses.decoded: They must not shave their heads bald, nor trim the edges of their beards, nor make any incisions in their bodies.

verses.kjv: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.
verses.decoded: They must be consecrated to their God and must not dishonor the name of their God, because they present the food offerings made by fire to the Lord, which are the provisions for their God. Therefore, they must be consecrated.

verses.kjv: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.
verses.decoded: They must not marry a woman who is a prostitute or who has been defiled; nor should they marry a woman who has been divorced from her husband, because he is consecrated to his God.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I the LORD, which sanctify you, am holy.
verses.decoded: Therefore, you must treat him as holy, because he presents the food offerings to your God. He must be considered holy by you, because I, the LORD, who makes you holy, am holy.

verses.kjv: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.
verses.decoded: If a priest's daughter dishonors herself by engaging in prostitution, she disgraces her father; she must be executed by burning.

verses.kjv: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;
verses.decoded: The high priest, who is the most prominent among his fellow priests, upon whose head the anointing oil has been poured, and who has been set apart to wear the special priestly garments,

verses.kjv: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;
verses.decoded: He must not go near any dead body, nor make himself ritually unclean for his father or for his mother.

verses.kjv: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: He must not leave the holy place, nor treat the holy place of his God as common or unholy, because the sacred anointing oil of his God is upon him, marking his consecration. I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
verses.decoded: He must marry a woman who is a virgin.

verses.kjv: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.
verses.decoded: He must not marry a widow, or a divorced woman, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. Instead, he must marry a virgin from his own people.

verses.kjv: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the LORD do sanctify him.
verses.decoded: He must not make his descendants illegitimate or dishonored among his people, because I, the Lord, set him apart as holy.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.
verses.decoded: Tell Aaron that any of his descendants throughout their generations who has a physical defect must not come near to present the food of his God.

verses.kjv: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,
verses.decoded: Because any man who has a physical defect must not come near: a man who is blind, or a man who is lame, or a man who has a disfigured nose, or anything that is extra or deformed.

verses.kjv: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,
verses.decoded: Or a man who has a broken foot or a broken hand,

verses.kjv: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;
verses.decoded: Or someone who is hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or who has a defect in his eye, or has a skin disease, or scabs, or has crushed testicles.

verses.kjv: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.
verses.decoded: No man among the descendants of Aaron the priest who has a physical defect is permitted to approach to present the Lord's offerings made by fire; because he has a defect, he must not approach to present the food of his God.

verses.kjv: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.
verses.decoded: He may eat the food dedicated to his God, both from the most sacred offerings and the sacred offerings.

verses.kjv: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the LORD do sanctify them.
verses.decoded: However, he must not go beyond the veil or approach the altar, because he has a physical defect; this is to prevent him from defiling my holy places, for I, the LORD, am the one who makes them holy.

verses.kjv: And Moses told it unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And Moses communicated this to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: Tell Aaron and his sons to keep themselves separate from the sacred offerings that the Israelites dedicate to me, so that they do not dishonor my holy name through those things which they set apart for me. I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations, that goeth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: Tell them: Any of your descendants throughout your generations who approaches the sacred offerings that the Israelites consecrate to the Lord, while still in a state of ritual impurity, that person will be excluded from my presence. I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;
verses.decoded: Any man among Aaron's descendants who has a severe skin disease or a bodily discharge must not eat from the sacred offerings until he is ritually clean.

verses.kjv: Or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;
verses.decoded: Or anyone who touches any crawling creature, by which he may become ritually unclean, or a person from whom he may contract uncleanness, whatever kind of uncleanness that person has;

verses.kjv: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.
verses.decoded: Any person who has touched something that makes them ritually impure will remain unclean until evening and must not eat from the sacred offerings, unless they wash their body with water.

verses.kjv: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it is his food.
verses.decoded: Once the sun has set, he will be considered ritually pure, and then he may consume the sacred food, because it is his rightful sustenance.

verses.kjv: That which dieth of itself, or is torn with beasts, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: A priest must not eat the meat of an animal that has died naturally or has been killed by wild animals, because doing so would make him ritually unclean. I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the LORD do sanctify them.
verses.decoded: Therefore, they must adhere to my regulation, so that they do not become guilty and die as a consequence, if they treat it as unholy. I, the LORD, am the one who consecrates them.

verses.kjv: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
verses.decoded: No outsider is permitted to eat from the sacred offerings; neither a guest residing with the priest nor a hired worker is allowed to eat from the sacred offerings.

verses.kjv: But if the priest buy any soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.
verses.decoded: However, if a priest acquires a person with his own money, that individual, along with anyone born into his household, may eat of his food.

verses.kjv: If the priest’s daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.
verses.decoded: If a priest's daughter marries someone outside the priestly family, she is not permitted to eat from the sacred offerings.

verses.kjv: But if the priest’s daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father’s house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father’s meat: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.
verses.decoded: However, if a priest's daughter becomes a widow or is divorced, and has no children, and she returns to her father's household, just as she was in her youth, she may then eat from her father's food supply.

verses.kjv: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.
verses.decoded: And if a person eats a sacred offering unintentionally, then that person must add one-fifth of its value to it, and give both the original sacred offering and the added amount to the priest.

verses.kjv: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the LORD;
verses.decoded: And they must not treat as common or defile the sacred offerings of the Israelites, which they present to the Lord.

verses.kjv: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the LORD do sanctify them.
verses.decoded: Or allow them to be held accountable for the wrongdoing of eating their sacred offerings, because I, the Lord, make them holy.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the LORD for a burnt offering;
verses.decoded: Speak to Aaron and his sons, and to all the people of Israel, and tell them: If any person from the house of Israel, or any foreigner residing in Israel, wishes to present his offering for any of his solemn promises or for any of his voluntary gifts, which they intend to offer to the LORD as a burnt offering;

verses.kjv: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.
verses.decoded: You are to offer voluntarily a male animal without any defect, from the cattle, sheep, or goats.

verses.kjv: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.
verses.decoded: But anything that has a defect, you must not offer; because it will not be accepted on your behalf.

verses.kjv: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.
verses.decoded: And anyone who presents a sacrifice of peace offerings to the Lord, either to fulfill a solemn promise or as a voluntary offering from cattle or sheep, it must be without defect to be acceptable; there must be no physical flaw in it.

verses.kjv: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: You must not offer to the LORD any animal that is blind, or has a broken bone, or is mutilated, or has a tumor, or a skin disease, or scabs. You must not present any of these as an offering made by fire to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
verses.decoded: You may offer a bull or a lamb that has an extra or missing body part as a freewill offering, but it will not be accepted for a vow.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not offer unto the LORD that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make any offering thereof in your land.
verses.decoded: You must not present to the Lord anything that is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; nor are you to make any offering of such things in your land.

verses.kjv: Neither from a stranger’s hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, and blemishes be in them: they shall not be accepted for you.
verses.decoded: You must not offer food for your God from the hand of a foreigner, using any of these animals, because they are corrupted and have defects; they will not be accepted on your behalf.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: When a young bull, or a lamb, or a young goat is born, it must remain with its mother for seven days. From the eighth day onward, it will be acceptable as an offering to the Lord, presented by fire.

verses.kjv: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.
verses.decoded: You must not slaughter a cow or a ewe and its offspring on the same day.

verses.kjv: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the LORD, offer it at your own will.
verses.decoded: And when you offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the Lord, offer it according to your own free will.

verses.kjv: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: It must be eaten completely on the same day; you must not leave any of it until the next day. I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: For this reason, you must observe my instructions and put them into practice: I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the LORD which hallow you,
verses.decoded: You must not dishonor my holy name; instead, I will be treated as holy among the people of Israel. I am the Lord who makes you holy.

verses.kjv: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: I am the one who brought you out of the land of Egypt, so that I could be your God: I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.
verses.decoded: Tell the people of Israel, and say to them, 'Regarding the LORD's appointed festivals, which you are to announce as sacred assemblies, these are indeed my festivals.'

verses.kjv: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.
verses.decoded: For six days, work may be performed, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, a sacred assembly. You must not do any work on it; it is the Lord's Sabbath in all your places of residence.

verses.kjv: These are the feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.
verses.decoded: These are the Lord's appointed festivals, which are sacred gatherings that you must announce at their designated times.

verses.kjv: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the LORD’s passover.
verses.decoded: On the fourteenth day of the first month, in the evening, is the Lord's Passover.

verses.kjv: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the LORD: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.
verses.decoded: And on the fifteenth day of that same month, the festival of unleavened bread for the Lord begins; for seven days you must eat unleavened bread.

verses.kjv: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.decoded: On the first day, you are to hold a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work on that day.

verses.kjv: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD seven days: in the seventh day is an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.decoded: However, you are to present an offering made by fire to the Lord for seven days. On the seventh day, there will be a sacred assembly, and you must not do any ordinary work on that day.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:
verses.decoded: Tell the people of Israel: When you enter the land that I am giving to you and you harvest its crops, you must then bring a bundle of the first grain you harvest to the priest.

verses.kjv: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
verses.decoded: The priest must present the sheaf by waving it before the Lord, so that you may be accepted. The priest shall wave it on the day after the Sabbath.

verses.kjv: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: And on that day when you present the sheaf, you must offer a one-year-old male lamb without any defect as a burnt offering to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the LORD for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.
verses.decoded: And its grain offering shall consist of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with olive oil, an offering made by fire to the Lord, a pleasing aroma; and its drink offering shall be a quarter of a hin of wine.

verses.kjv: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.decoded: You must not eat any bread, nor roasted grain, nor fresh grain until the very day you have presented an offering to your God. This is to be a permanent regulation for all your future generations, wherever you live.

verses.kjv: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:
verses.decoded: And you shall count for yourselves from the day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the bundle of grain for the wave offering; seven full weeks shall be completed.

verses.kjv: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: You are to count fifty days until the day after the seventh Sabbath, and then you must present a new grain offering to the Lord.

verses.kjv: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: You shall bring from your dwellings two loaves of bread for a wave offering, each made from two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour; they shall be baked with yeast; they are the first produce offered to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be for a burnt offering unto the LORD, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: And you shall present along with the bread seven unblemished male lambs, each one year old, and one young bull, and two rams. These animals are to be a burnt offering to the LORD, accompanied by their grain offering and their drink offerings. This is an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
verses.decoded: Then you are to sacrifice one young goat as an offering for sin, and two lambs that are one year old as a peace offering.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
verses.decoded: The priest must present these items as a special offering before the Lord, along with the bread made from the first harvest and the two lambs. These offerings are sacred to the Lord and are designated for the priest.

verses.kjv: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
verses.decoded: And you must announce on that very same day that it is to be a sacred assembly for you; you are not to perform any laborious work on it. This is to be a permanent law wherever you live.

verses.kjv: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: When you harvest the crops from your land, you must not completely clear the edges of your field as you harvest, nor should you collect any leftover stalks or grains from your harvest. You must leave these for the poor and for foreigners. I am the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.
verses.decoded: Tell the Israelites: On the first day of the seventh month, you are to observe a day of complete rest, commemorated with trumpet blasts, a sacred assembly.

verses.kjv: Ye shall do no servile work therein: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: You must not do any regular work on that day; instead, you must present an offering made by fire to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: Also, on the tenth day of this seventh month there will be a Day of Atonement; it will be a sacred assembly for you, and you must deny yourselves.

verses.kjv: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: And you must not do any work on that same day, because it is a Day of Atonement, designated to make reconciliation for you before the Lord your God.

verses.kjv: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.decoded: Indeed, any person who does not humble themselves on that particular day will be separated from their community.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.
verses.decoded: And any person who does any work on that specific day, I will eliminate that person from their community.

verses.kjv: Ye shall do no manner of work: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.decoded: You must not do any kind of work; this will be a permanent law for all your descendants, wherever you live.

verses.kjv: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.
verses.decoded: This will be a day of complete rest for you, and you must deny yourselves. On the ninth day of the month, in the evening, from that evening until the following evening, you are to observe your day of rest.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: Tell the people of Israel: On the fifteenth day of this seventh month, there will be the Festival of Shelters (or Booths) for seven days, dedicated to the Lord.

verses.kjv: On the first day shall be an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.decoded: On the first day, there is to be a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work on it.

verses.kjv: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it is a solemn assembly; and ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.decoded: For seven days you must present an offering made by fire to the Lord. On the eighth day, you are to have a sacred assembly, and you must present an offering made by fire to the Lord.

verses.kjv: These are the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:
verses.decoded: These are the Lord's appointed festivals, which you are to declare as sacred assemblies, for presenting offerings made by fire to the Lord: a burnt offering, a grain offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its designated day.

verses.kjv: Beside the sabbaths of the LORD, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: In addition to the Lord's Sabbaths, and your gifts, and all your vows, and all your freewill offerings that you give to the Lord.

verses.kjv: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days: on the first day shall be a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.
verses.decoded: Additionally, on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, after you have harvested the produce of the land, you must observe a festival to the Lord for seven days: the first day will be a day of complete rest, and the eighth day will also be a day of complete rest.

verses.kjv: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.
verses.decoded: On the first day, you are to take branches from beautiful trees, fronds from palm trees, branches from leafy trees, and willows from the stream; and you are to celebrate before the Lord your God for seven days.

verses.kjv: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the LORD seven days in the year. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
verses.decoded: And you shall observe it as a festival to the Lord for seven days each year. This is to be a permanent law for all your future generations: you shall celebrate it in the seventh month.

verses.kjv: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:
verses.decoded: You must live in temporary shelters for seven days; all native-born Israelites must live in temporary shelters.

verses.kjv: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: So that your descendants will know that I made the Israelites live in temporary shelters when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.

verses.kjv: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the LORD.
verses.decoded: And Moses announced to the Israelites the festivals of the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.
verses.decoded: Instruct the Israelites to bring you pure olive oil, extracted by pressing, for the light, so that the lamps may burn continuously.

verses.kjv: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the LORD continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.
verses.decoded: Outside the curtain of the covenant, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron is to arrange it from evening until morning before the Lord continuously.

verses.kjv: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the LORD continually.
verses.decoded: He is to arrange the lamps on the pure lampstand before the Lord continually.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.
verses.decoded: And you shall take fine flour, and bake twelve loaves from it; each loaf shall contain two-tenths of an ephah of flour.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the LORD.
verses.decoded: You are to arrange them in two stacks, with six in each stack, on the ritually clean table in the presence of the Lord.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: And you shall place pure frankincense on each row, so that it may be with the bread as a reminder, specifically, an offering presented by fire to the Lord.

verses.kjv: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.
verses.decoded: On every Sabbath, the priest must arrange it before the Lord as a continuous practice, as it is provided by the Israelites according to a perpetual covenant.

verses.kjv: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.
