verses.decoded: It will belong to Aaron and his sons; and they are to eat it in a sacred place, because it is considered extremely sacred to him from the offerings presented to the Lord by fire, as a permanent regulation.

verses.kjv: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;
verses.decoded: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the people of Israel. This son of the Israelite woman and an Israelite man had a dispute in the camp.

verses.kjv: And the Israelitish woman’s son blasphemed the name of the Lord, and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)
verses.decoded: The son of the Israelite woman spoke profanely against the name of the Lord and uttered curses. So, they brought him to Moses (his mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, from the tribe of Dan).

verses.kjv: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them.
verses.decoded: And they placed him in custody, so that the Lord's decision could be revealed to them.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
verses.decoded: Bring the one who has cursed outside the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let the entire assembly stone him.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.
verses.decoded: You are to tell the Israelites that anyone who curses their God will be held responsible for their sin.

verses.kjv: And he that blasphemeth the name of the LORD, he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the Lord, shall be put to death.
verses.decoded: And anyone who disrespects the name of the Lord will certainly be executed. The entire community must stone him to death. This applies equally to foreigners and those born in the land; when such a person disrespects the name of the Lord, he must be executed.

verses.kjv: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.
verses.decoded: And anyone who kills another person will certainly be put to death.

verses.kjv: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.
verses.decoded: If someone kills another person's animal, they must compensate for it; an animal for an animal.

verses.kjv: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;
verses.decoded: And if a person causes a physical injury to their neighbor, then whatever injury they inflicted, the same injury shall be inflicted upon them.

verses.kjv: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again.
verses.decoded: An injury for an injury, an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth. Just as he has inflicted a permanent injury upon another person, so the same shall be done to him.

verses.kjv: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.
verses.decoded: And anyone who kills an animal must replace it; and anyone who kills a human being must be put to death.

verses.kjv: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: You must have the same law for the foreigner as for your own people, because I am the Lord your God.

verses.kjv: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And Moses spoke to the Israelites, telling them to bring the person who had cursed outside the camp and stone him to death with rocks.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: Speak to the Israelites and tell them: 'When you enter the land that I am giving you, the land must observe a Sabbath rest for the Lord.'

verses.kjv: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;
verses.decoded: For six years you shall plant your fields, and for six years you shall prune your vineyards, and gather their produce.

verses.kjv: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
verses.decoded: However, during the seventh year, the land must observe a complete rest, a Sabbath dedicated to the Lord. You must not plant crops in your fields or prune your grapevines.

verses.kjv: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.
verses.decoded: What grows on its own from your harvest you must not harvest, nor gather the grapes from your unpruned vine, because it is a year of rest for the land.

verses.kjv: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,
verses.decoded: And the produce of the land during its Sabbath year will serve as food for you; for you, and for your male servant, and for your female servant, and for your hired worker, and for the foreigner who resides among you.

verses.kjv: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.
verses.decoded: And for your livestock, and for the wild animals in your land, all the produce of the land will be food for them.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.
verses.decoded: You are to count seven cycles of seven years, which amounts to forty-nine years; this period of seven cycles of seven years will be for you.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.
verses.decoded: Then you must ensure that the trumpet of the Jubilee is sounded on the tenth day of the seventh month; on the Day of Atonement, you must blow the trumpet.

verses.kjv: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
verses.decoded: And you shall make the fiftieth year holy, and announce freedom throughout all the land to all its residents: it will be a special year of celebration for you;

verses.kjv: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.
verses.decoded: The fiftieth year will be a Jubilee for you. In that year, you must not plant seeds, nor harvest what grows on its own, nor gather grapes from your untended vines.

verses.kjv: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
verses.decoded: Because it is the Jubilee year, it will be sacred to you; you may eat what grows naturally from the fields.

verses.kjv: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.
verses.decoded: In this year of jubilee, everyone shall return to their own property.

verses.kjv: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour’s hand, ye shall not oppress one another:
verses.decoded: And if you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy anything from your neighbor, you shall not exploit one another.

verses.kjv: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:
verses.decoded: You are to buy from your neighbor based on the number of years remaining until the Jubilee, and he is to sell to you based on the number of years of harvests remaining.

verses.kjv: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.
verses.decoded: You must increase its price based on the greater number of years remaining until the Jubilee, and you must decrease its price based on the fewer number of years remaining, because what is being sold to you is the value of the harvests until the Jubilee.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God:for I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: Therefore, you must not exploit or take advantage of one another; instead, you must revere your God, because I am the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
verses.decoded: Therefore, you must follow my laws and observe my decrees, and put them into practice; then you will live safely in the land.

verses.kjv: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
verses.decoded: The land will produce its crops, and you will eat until you are satisfied, and live there securely.

verses.kjv: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:
verses.decoded: And if you say, 'What will we eat in the seventh year? Look, we will not plant seeds, nor gather our harvest.'

verses.kjv: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.
verses.decoded: Then I will order my blessing to be upon you in the sixth year, and the land will produce enough harvest for three years.

verses.kjv: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store.
verses.decoded: And you will sow in the eighth year, and you will still eat from the old produce until the ninth year; until its new harvest comes in, you will eat from the old stored provisions.

verses.kjv: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.
verses.decoded: The land must not be sold permanently, because the land belongs to me; for you are temporary residents and guests with me.

verses.kjv: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.
verses.decoded: And throughout all the land that you possess, you must allow for the redemption of the land.

verses.kjv: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.
verses.decoded: If your fellow Israelite becomes poor and has to sell some of his property, and if one of his relatives comes to buy it back, then that relative must buy back what his brother sold.

verses.kjv: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;
verses.decoded: And if the man has no one to buy it back, but he himself becomes capable of buying it back;

verses.kjv: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.
verses.decoded: Then he must calculate the number of years since the sale, and return the remaining value to the man from whom he bought it, so that the original owner can reclaim his property.

verses.kjv: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
verses.decoded: But if he is unable to buy it back, then what was sold will remain in the possession of the one who bought it until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee, it will be released, and he will return to his property.

verses.kjv: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.
verses.decoded: If a person sells a residential house within a fortified city, they have the right to buy it back within one full year after the sale; indeed, they may redeem it within that full year.

verses.kjv: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.
verses.decoded: And if it is not bought back within a full year, then the house located in the walled city will permanently belong to the person who bought it and their descendants; it will not be returned during the Jubilee year.

verses.kjv: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.
verses.decoded: However, houses in villages that are not surrounded by walls will be considered as open agricultural land. They can be bought back, and they will be returned to their original owners in the Jubilee year.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
verses.decoded: However, concerning the cities of the Levites and the houses within the cities they possess, the Levites are permitted to buy them back at any time.

verses.kjv: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: If a man buys property from the Levites, then the house that was sold, along with the city where it is located, must be returned in the Year of Jubilee. This is because the houses in the Levites' cities are their permanent inheritance among the Israelites.

verses.kjv: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
verses.decoded: However, the open land surrounding their cities must not be sold, because it is their permanent property.

verses.kjv: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.
verses.decoded: If your fellow Israelite becomes poor and is unable to support himself among you, then you must help him, even if he is a foreigner or a temporary resident, so that he can continue to live with you.

verses.kjv: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.
verses.decoded: Do not charge him interest or any additional amount. Instead, respect your God, so that your fellow Israelite can continue to live with you.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.
verses.decoded: You must not lend him your money with interest, nor lend him your food for profit.

verses.kjv: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
verses.decoded: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

verses.kjv: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
verses.decoded: If your fellow Israelite living among you becomes poor and sells himself to you, you must not force him to serve as a slave.

verses.kjv: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:
verses.decoded: However, he is to remain with you as a hired worker or a temporary resident, and he will serve you until the Year of Jubilee.

verses.kjv: And then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
verses.decoded: Then he and his children with him will leave you and return to his own family, and he will go back to the property that belonged to his ancestors.

verses.kjv: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
verses.decoded: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt; therefore, they must not be sold as enslaved persons.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.
verses.decoded: You must not rule over him harshly, but you must revere your God.

verses.kjv: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.
verses.decoded: Both your male and female enslaved persons, whom you may acquire, shall be from the foreign nations that are around you; from them you may purchase male and female enslaved persons.

verses.kjv: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, you may purchase children from the foreigners who live among you, and from their families who are with you, specifically those born in your land. They will become your property.

verses.kjv: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.
verses.decoded: You may take them as property to be inherited by your children after you, to own them as a possession; they will be your enslaved servants permanently. However, you must not rule over your fellow Israelites, your own people, with harshness.

verses.kjv: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger’s family:
verses.decoded: And if a temporary resident or a foreigner living among you becomes wealthy, and your fellow Israelite who lives near him becomes poor and sells himself to that temporary resident or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the foreigner's family:

verses.kjv: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:
verses.decoded: After he has been sold, he may be bought back; one of his relatives may redeem him.

verses.kjv: Either his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.
verses.decoded: His uncle, or his uncle's son, or any close relative from his family, may buy him back; or if he becomes financially able, he may buy himself back.

verses.kjv: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.
verses.decoded: The person (or their redeemer) will calculate with the buyer the remaining value from the year of the sale until the Year of Jubilee. The redemption price will be based on the number of years left, as if it were the wages for a hired worker.

verses.kjv: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
verses.decoded: If there are still many years remaining until the Jubilee, he must repay the cost of his redemption in proportion to those remaining years, based on the original purchase price.

verses.kjv: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.
verses.decoded: And if only a few years remain until the Year of Jubilee, then he must calculate with him, and according to the number of his remaining years, he must return to him the price of his redemption.

verses.kjv: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.
verses.decoded: He is to be treated like a worker hired for a year; and the other person must not rule over him with harshness in your presence.

verses.kjv: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.
verses.decoded: And if he is not bought back during these years, then he and his children will be released in the Year of Jubilee.

verses.kjv: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: Because the Israelites are my servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.

verses.kjv: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: You must not make any idols for yourselves, nor any carved image, nor erect a sacred pillar, nor place any stone figure in your land to worship it.

verses.kjv: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: You must observe my Sabbaths and show reverence for my sanctuary: I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
verses.decoded: If you follow my laws, and obey my commands, and carry them out;

verses.kjv: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
verses.decoded: Then I will provide you with rain at the appropriate time, and the land will produce its harvest, and the trees in the field will bear their fruit.

verses.kjv: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
verses.decoded: Your grain threshing will continue until the grape harvest, and the grape harvest will continue until the time for planting seeds. You will eat your fill of food and live securely in your land.

verses.kjv: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
verses.decoded: And I will bring peace to the land, and you will lie down to rest, and no one will make you afraid. I will also remove dangerous animals from the land, and no war will come upon your land.

verses.kjv: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.decoded: And you will pursue your enemies, and they will be defeated by you in battle.

verses.kjv: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.decoded: And five of you will pursue one hundred, and one hundred of you will cause ten thousand to flee; and your enemies will be defeated by the sword before you.

verses.kjv: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.
verses.decoded: For I will show you favor, and I will make you prosperous, and I will increase your numbers, and I will confirm my agreement with you.

verses.kjv: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.
verses.decoded: And you will eat from your old harvest, and you will remove the old to make room for the new.

verses.kjv: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.
verses.decoded: And I will establish my dwelling place among you: and I will not reject you.

verses.kjv: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
verses.decoded: And I will be present among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.

verses.kjv: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.
verses.decoded: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt so that you would no longer be their slaves; and I have broken the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk upright.

verses.kjv: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;
verses.decoded: But if you will not listen to me, and will not obey all these commands;

verses.kjv: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but that ye break my covenant:
verses.decoded: And if you reject my laws, or if you deeply dislike my rulings, so that you refuse to obey all my commands, but instead break my covenant:

verses.kjv: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
verses.decoded: I will also do this to you; I will bring upon you terror, wasting diseases, and feverish illnesses that will dim your sight and cause you deep sadness; and you will plant your crops to no avail, because your enemies will consume them.

verses.kjv: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.
verses.decoded: And I will turn against you, and you will be defeated by your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you, and you will run away even when no one is chasing you.

verses.kjv: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
verses.decoded: And if, even after all this, you still will not listen to me, then I will punish you seven times more severely for your sins.

verses.kjv: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:
verses.decoded: I will break your arrogant strength; and I will make your sky like iron, and your land like bronze.

verses.kjv: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.
verses.decoded: Your efforts will be wasted, because your land will not produce its harvest, and the trees of the land will not yield their fruit.

verses.kjv: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.
verses.decoded: And if you act in defiance of me and refuse to listen to me, I will bring seven times more severe punishments upon you in proportion to your sins.

verses.kjv: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.
verses.decoded: I will also send wild animals among you, which will take your children from you, destroy your livestock, and reduce your numbers, so that your main roads will become deserted.

verses.kjv: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;
verses.decoded: And if you will not allow yourselves to be changed by me through these things, but instead continue to act in opposition to me.

verses.kjv: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
verses.decoded: Then I will also oppose you, and I will punish you seven times more for your sins.

verses.kjv: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
verses.decoded: And I will bring war upon you, which will punish you for breaking my covenant. Even when you gather yourselves together within your cities, I will send a deadly disease among you, and you will be handed over to your enemies.

verses.kjv: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.
verses.decoded: When I have severely limited your food supply, ten women will bake your bread in a single oven, and they will distribute your bread to you by weight; you will eat, but you will not feel full.

verses.kjv: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;
verses.decoded: And if, despite all these things, you still will not listen to me, but instead act in opposition to me;

verses.kjv: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.
verses.decoded: Then I will oppose you with fierce anger; and I myself will punish you seven times over for your sins.

verses.kjv: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.
verses.decoded: And you will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.

verses.kjv: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.
verses.decoded: And I will demolish your places of worship on hills, and chop down your carved idols, and throw your dead bodies onto the dead bodies of your idols, and I will detest you.

verses.kjv: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.
verses.decoded: I will turn your cities into ruins, and make your places of worship desolate, and I will not accept the pleasing aroma of your offerings.

verses.kjv: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
verses.decoded: I will make the land desolate, and your enemies who live there will be astonished by it.

verses.kjv: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.
verses.decoded: And I will disperse you among the nations, and I will pursue you with a sword; your land will become desolate, and your cities will be left in ruins.

verses.kjv: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies’ land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.
verses.decoded: Then the land will observe its Sabbath years, as long as it lies desolate and you are in the land of your enemies; even then the land will rest and observe its Sabbath years.

verses.kjv: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.
verses.decoded: As long as it remains desolate, the land will have its rest, because it did not rest during your Sabbaths when you lived upon it.

verses.kjv: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.
verses.decoded: For those of you who survive, I will cause them to be filled with dread in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a rustling leaf will make them flee, and they will run away as if escaping from a sword; and they will stumble and fall even when no one is chasing them.

verses.kjv: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
verses.decoded: And they will stumble over one another, as if fleeing from a sword, even when no one is pursuing them; and you will be powerless to stand against your enemies.

verses.kjv: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
verses.decoded: And you will be destroyed among the foreign nations, and the land of your enemies will consume you.

verses.kjv: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.
verses.decoded: Those of you who remain will waste away because of their own wrongdoing in the lands of your enemies; and they will also waste away there because of the wrongdoing of their ancestors.

verses.kjv: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;
verses.decoded: If they confess their wrongdoing, and the wrongdoing of their ancestors, along with the disloyalty they committed against me, and that they also acted in opposition to me;

verses.kjv: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:
verses.decoded: And that I, too, have acted in opposition to them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their rebellious hearts become humble,

verses.kjv: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.
verses.decoded: At that time, I will remember my solemn promise to Jacob, and also my solemn promise to Isaac, and I will also remember my solemn promise to Abraham; and I will remember the land.

verses.kjv: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, the land will be abandoned by them and will experience its periods of rest, while it lies desolate without them. And they will accept the consequences of their wrongdoing, because they rejected my laws and because their inner being detested my decrees.

verses.kjv: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the LORD their God.
verses.decoded: Despite all of this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, nor will I despise them to completely destroy them or break my covenant with them, because I am the Lord their God.

verses.kjv: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: However, for their benefit, I will recall the agreement I made with their forefathers, whom I led out of the land of Egypt in the presence of other nations, so that I might be their God. I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
verses.decoded: These are the decrees, the legal decisions, and the instructions that the Lord established between himself and the people of Israel on Mount Sinai through Moses.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the LORD by thy estimation.
verses.decoded: Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When a person makes a special vow to dedicate individuals to the Lord, their value will be determined by your assessment.

verses.kjv: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.decoded: If your valuation is for a male between twenty and sixty years old, then your valuation will be fifty shekels of silver, according to the standard sanctuary shekel.

verses.kjv: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.
verses.decoded: And if the person is female, then your valuation will be thirty shekels.

verses.kjv: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.decoded: If the person is between five and twenty years old, your valuation for a male will be twenty shekels, and for a female, ten shekels.

verses.kjv: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.
verses.decoded: If the individual is between one month and five years of age, then the assessed value for a male will be five shekels of silver, and for a female, the assessed value will be three shekels of silver.

verses.kjv: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.decoded: If the person is sixty years old or older, and if it is a male, then your valuation will be fifteen shekels, and for a female, it will be ten shekels.

verses.kjv: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.
verses.decoded: However, if the person is too poor to pay the amount you have estimated, then he must appear before the priest, and the priest will determine his value based on what he can afford.

verses.kjv: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD, all that any man giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.
verses.decoded: If someone dedicates an animal that is acceptable as an offering to the Lord, then everything that person gives from such an animal to the Lord will be considered sacred.

verses.kjv: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.
verses.decoded: He must not change it or exchange it, neither a better one for a worse one, nor a worse one for a better one. And if he does exchange one animal for another, then both the original animal and the exchanged animal will be considered holy.

verses.kjv: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD, then he shall present the beast before the priest:
verses.decoded: If the vow involves any animal considered unclean, which cannot be offered as a sacrifice to the Lord, then the person must bring that animal to the priest.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, who art the priest, so shall it be.
verses.decoded: The priest will assess its value, whether it is in good condition or poor. The value will be determined by your assessment, since you are the priest.

verses.kjv: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.
verses.decoded: However, if someone wishes to redeem it, they must add one-fifth to the value you have determined.

verses.kjv: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the LORD, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
verses.decoded: When a person dedicates their house to the Lord as holy, then the priest will assess its value, whether it is high or low; the value determined by the priest will be final.

verses.kjv: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.
verses.decoded: And if the person who dedicated it wishes to buy back his house, then he must add one-fifth of its assessed value to it, and it will become his.

verses.kjv: And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
verses.decoded: If a man dedicates a portion of his owned field to the Lord, then its value will be determined by the amount of seed required for it; a homer of barley seed will be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

verses.kjv: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.
verses.decoded: If someone dedicates his field to the Lord starting from the Year of Jubilee, its value will be determined by your assessment.

verses.kjv: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.
verses.decoded: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee year, then the priest will calculate the money owed to him based on the number of years remaining until the next Jubilee year, and that amount will be deducted from your valuation.

verses.kjv: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
verses.decoded: And if the person who dedicated the field wishes to reclaim it, then he must add one-fifth of the assessed value to the payment, and the field will then belong to him.

verses.kjv: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
verses.decoded: And if he does not buy back the field, or if he has sold the field to another person, it can no longer be bought back.

verses.kjv: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest’s.
verses.decoded: However, when the field is released in the Year of Jubilee, it will be consecrated to the Lord as a dedicated field; its ownership will belong to the priests.

verses.kjv: And if a man sanctify unto the LORD a field which he hath bought, which is not of the fields of his possession;
verses.decoded: If a man dedicates to the Lord a field that he has purchased, which is not part of his inherited property,

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, even unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: Then the priest will calculate for him the value of your dedication, considering the time remaining until the Year of Jubilee; and on that day, he must pay the assessed value as a sacred offering to the Lord.

verses.kjv: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land did belong.
verses.decoded: In the year of the Jubilee, the field will return to the person from whom it was purchased, specifically to the one who originally owned the land.

verses.kjv: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
verses.decoded: And all your valuations must be based on the standard sanctuary shekel: a shekel is equivalent to twenty gerahs.

verses.kjv: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD’s firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the LORD’s.
verses.decoded: However, no one may dedicate the firstborn of an animal, which already belongs to the Lord as a firstborn; whether it is an ox or a sheep, it is already the Lord's.

verses.kjv: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.
verses.decoded: If the animal is considered unclean, then the owner must buy it back at the value you have set, and add an additional one-fifth of that value to the price. However, if it is not bought back, then it will be sold at the value you have set.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the LORD of all that he hath, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: However, nothing that a person dedicates completely to the Lord from all that they own—whether a person, an animal, or a portion of their inherited land—can be sold or bought back. Everything completely dedicated is most holy to the Lord.

verses.kjv: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.
verses.decoded: No one who has been irrevocably dedicated by people (to destruction) can be bought back or set free; they must certainly be put to death.

verses.kjv: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD’s: it is holy unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: And every tenth part of the produce of the land, whether from the crops of the field or the fruit of the trees, belongs to the LORD; it is sacred to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.
verses.decoded: If a person wishes to buy back any part of his tithes, he must add one-fifth to its value.

verses.kjv: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: Regarding the tenth part of cattle or sheep, specifically any animal that passes under the shepherd's counting rod, that tenth animal will be set apart as sacred to the Lord.

verses.kjv: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
verses.decoded: One must not inspect whether it is good or bad, nor should one exchange it. If one does exchange it, then both the original and the exchanged item will be considered sacred; it cannot be bought back.

verses.kjv: These are the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.
verses.decoded: These are the commands that the Lord gave to Moses for the people of Israel on Mount Sinai.
